```{r data-object}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
cs0 <- function(A) rbind(0, matrixStats::colCumsums(A))
rollC <- function(C0, W) { Tn <- nrow(C0) - 1L; out <- matrix(NA_real_, Tn, ncol(C0))
  if (W >= 1 && W <= Tn) out[W:Tn, ] <- C0[(W + 1):(Tn + 1), , drop = FALSE] - C0[1:(Tn - W + 1), , drop = FALSE]; out }
shiftR <- function(S, h) { Tn <- nrow(S); out <- matrix(NA_real_, Tn, ncol(S))
  if (h < Tn) out[(h + 1):Tn, ] <- S[1:(Tn - h), , drop = FALSE]; out }
first_valid <- function(S) { i <- max.col(t((!is.na(S)) * 1), ties.method = "first")
  v <- S[cbind(i, seq_len(ncol(S)))]; v[is.na(v)] <- 0; v }
add_months <- function(d, k) {
  lt <- as.POSIXlt(d); y <- lt$year + 1900; mo <- lt$mon + k; y2 <- y + mo %/% 12; mo2 <- mo %% 12
  nxt <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", y2 + (mo2 + 1) %/% 12, (mo2 + 1) %% 12 + 1))
  as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", y2, mo2 + 1, pmin(lt$mday, as.integer(format(nxt - 1, "%d")))))
}
new_memo <- function() { m <- new.env(); for (nm in names(MEMO_CAP)) { e <- new.env(); e$keys <- character(0)
  e$cap <- MEMO_CAP[[nm]]; assign(nm, e, envir = m) }; m }
memo <- function(D, type, key, maker) {
  e <- get(type, envir = D$memo); k <- paste(key, collapse = "_")
  if (exists(k, envir = e, inherits = FALSE)) return(get(k, envir = e))
  v <- maker(); assign(k, v, envir = e); e$keys <- c(e$keys, k)
  if (length(e$keys) > e$cap) { rm(list = e$keys[1], envir = e); e$keys <- e$keys[-1] }
  v
}

# Signed transforms, scaled by the EXPANDING median of |x| (row k only uses rows 1..k: no lookahead).
exp_med_abs <- function(x) { out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x)); for (k in seq_along(x)) { v <- abs(x[1:k]); v <- v[is.finite(v) & v > 0]
  if (length(v)) out[k] <- median(v) }; out }
slog  <- function(x, sc) sign(x) * log1p(abs(x) / sc)
ssqrt <- function(x, sc) sign(x) * sqrt(abs(x) / sc)
add_transforms <- function(X) {
  if (TRANSFORM_MODE != "candidates") return(X)
  SC <- apply(X, 2, exp_med_abs)
  XL <- slog(X, SC); XS <- ssqrt(X, SC)
  colnames(XL) <- paste0(colnames(X), "__slog"); colnames(XS) <- paste0(colnames(X), "__ssqrt")
  cbind(X, XL, XS)
}
make_data <- function(MON, DAY) {
  X <- add_transforms(MON$X); y <- MON$y
  X0 <- sweep(X, 2, first_valid(X)); M <- (!is.na(X0) & !is.na(y)) * 1
  Xm <- X0; Xm[M == 0] <- 0; y0 <- ifelse(is.na(y), 0, y); Ym <- M * y0
  D <- list(Tn = length(y), V = ncol(X), vars = colnames(X), dates = MON$dates, y = y, X = X,
            C = list(M = cs0(M), X = cs0(Xm), Y = cs0(Ym), XX = cs0(Xm * Xm), YY = cs0(Ym * y0), XY = cs0(Xm * Ym)),
            memo = new_memo())
  dd <- DAY$Date; nd <- length(dd); day_ym <- format(dd, "%Y-%m"); mon_ym <- format(MON$dates, "%Y-%m")
  D$first_day <- match(mon_ym, day_ym); D$last_day <- nd - match(mon_ym, rev(day_ym)) + 1
  if (ENTRY_DAY == 0) D$entry_idx <- D$last_day else {
    nxt <- format(add_months(MON$dates, 1), "%Y-%m"); f <- match(nxt, day_ym); cand <- f + ENTRY_DAY - 1
    D$entry_idx <- ifelse(!is.na(cand) & cand <= nd & day_ym[pmin(cand, nd)] == nxt, cand, NA_integer_)
  }
  tgt <- add_months(dd, MAX_HOLD_M); D$mh_idx <- findInterval(tgt, dd); D$mh_full <- tgt <= dd[nd]
  D$ddates <- dd; D$r <- DAY$r; D$L <- cumsum(log1p(DAY$r)); D$n_days <- nd
  D
}
truncate_inputs <- function(MON, DAY, k) {
  cut <- max(DAY$Date[format(DAY$Date, "%Y-%m") == format(MON$dates[k], "%Y-%m")])
  list(MON = list(dates = MON$dates[1:k], y = MON$y[1:k], X = MON$X[1:k, , drop = FALSE]), DAY = DAY[DAY$Date <= cut, ])
}
D <- make_data(MON, DAY)
if (length(setdiff(FORCE_VARS, D$vars))) warning("FORCE_VARS not found in ", DATA_FILE, " (ignored): ", paste(setdiff(FORCE_VARS, D$vars), collapse = ", "))
```

**Lookahead check.** Rolling statistics come from cumulative sums. Each row *k* only uses rows up to *k*. The entry day is always after the signal month's close.

# 3. Variable statistics (Rules 2–6)

Per-variable rolling regressions: p-value, adjusted R², coefficient, the standardised p-value −log(p), rolling z-scores, and the per-variable out-of-sample R² (`Train_MO`/`Test_MO`) with its z-score. All are computed in closed form from cumulative sums and stored for reuse.

```{r sheets}
reg_sheet <- function(D, W) memo(D, "reg", W, function() {
  C <- D$C; n <- rollC(C$M, W); Sx <- rollC(C$X, W); Sy <- rollC(C$Y, W)
  Sxx <- rollC(C$XX, W); Syy <- rollC(C$YY, W); Sxy <- rollC(C$XY, W)
  Sxxc <- Sxx - Sx^2 / n; Syyc <- Syy - Sy^2 / n; Sxyc <- Sxy - Sx * Sy / n
  ok <- !is.na(n) & n >= max(3, ceiling(MIN_OBS_FRAC * W)) & Sxxc > 1e-12 * (Sxx + 1e-300) & Syyc > 0
  beta <- Sxyc / Sxxc; R2 <- pmin(pmax(Sxyc^2 / (Sxxc * Syyc), 0), 1); df <- n - 2
  P <- suppressWarnings(2 * pt(-abs(beta / sqrt(pmax(Syyc - beta * Sxyc, 0) / df / Sxxc)), df))
  Adj <- 1 - (1 - R2) * (n - 1) / df
  P[!ok] <- NA; beta[!ok] <- NA; Adj[!ok] <- NA
  Pstd <- -log(pmax(P, 1e-300))
  Pstd <- switch(P_TRANSFORM,
                 loglog = log1p(Pstd),                                                  # smooth compression, no cap
                 rank   = t(apply(Pstd, 1, function(v) rank(v, na.last = "keep") / sum(!is.na(v)))),  # within-month percentile
                 raw    = Pstd)
  list(P = P, Pstd = Pstd, AdjR2 = Adj, Coef = beta)
})
z_roll <- function(S, Z) {
  ok0 <- !is.na(S); Sc <- sweep(S, 2, first_valid(S)); Sc[!ok0] <- 0
  n <- rollC(cs0(ok0 * 1), Z); s1 <- rollC(cs0(Sc), Z); s2 <- rollC(cs0(Sc^2), Z)
  mu <- s1 / n; v <- (s2 - s1 * mu) / (n - 1); z <- suppressWarnings((Sc - mu) / sqrt(v))
  z[!(ok0 & !is.na(n) & n >= max(3, ceiling(MIN_OBS_FRAC * Z)) & v > 1e-14)] <- NA; z
}
zreg_sheet <- function(D, W, Z) memo(D, "zreg", c(W, Z), function() {
  R <- reg_sheet(D, W); list(zP = z_roll(R$Pstd, Z), zA = z_roll(R$AdjR2, Z), zC = z_roll(R$Coef, Z)) })
oos_sheet <- function(D, Tr, Te) memo(D, "oos", c(Tr, Te), function() {
  C <- D$C; tr <- function(nm) shiftR(rollC(C[[nm]], Tr), Te); te <- function(nm) rollC(C[[nm]], Te)
  n1 <- tr("M"); x1 <- tr("X"); y1 <- tr("Y"); xx1 <- tr("XX"); xy1 <- tr("XY")
  n2 <- te("M"); x2 <- te("X"); y2 <- te("Y"); xx2 <- te("XX"); yy2 <- te("YY"); xy2 <- te("XY")
  Sxxc <- xx1 - x1^2 / n1; beta <- (xy1 - x1 * y1 / n1) / Sxxc; alpha <- y1 / n1 - beta * x1 / n1; ybar <- y1 / n1
  SSE <- yy2 - 2 * alpha * y2 - 2 * beta * xy2 + alpha^2 * n2 + 2 * alpha * beta * x2 + beta^2 * xx2
  SST <- yy2 - 2 * ybar * y2 + ybar^2 * n2; out <- 1 - SSE / SST
  ok <- !is.na(n1) & !is.na(n2) & n1 >= max(3, ceiling(MIN_OBS_FRAC * Tr)) & n2 >= max(1, ceiling(MIN_OBS_FRAC * Te)) &
        Sxxc > 1e-12 * (xx1 + 1e-300) & SST > 1e-14
  out[!ok] <- NA; out
})
zoos_sheet <- function(D, Tr, Te, Z) memo(D, "zoos", c(Tr, Te, Z), function() z_roll(oos_sheet(D, Tr, Te), Z))
```

# 4. Scoring, selection and the nowcast model (Rule 7)

$$\text{Score} = a\,p_{std} + d\,L(z_{\bar R^2}) + f\,R^2_{OOS},\quad p_{std} = \log(1 - \log p),\quad L(z) = -\log(|z| + 0.01)$$

The weights in use are set by `WEIGHTS` (default a, d, f: significance, stability of R² and per-variable out-of-sample R²). With `P_TRANSFORM = "loglog"` (default), the significance term is p_std = log(1 + (−log p)): smaller p-values always score higher, but values near p = 0 no longer explode.

For a given month *t* and window pair:

- **Windows:**
  - The **test window** is the `Test_Win` months ending at *t* − 1. With `TEST_INCLUDES_TRADE_MONTH = TRUE`, it ends at *t* instead.
  - The **training window** is the `Train_Win` months just before the test window.
- **Selection:** variables are chosen with the scores at the **end of the training window**. The top-ranked variables are taken in order, skipping any whose correlation with an already chosen one exceeds `Corr_t`, until `n` are chosen. `n` must stay between 3 and min(8, ⌊Train_Win/12⌋, ⌊Test_Win/8⌋).
- **Model fit and objective:** the model is fitted on the training window and predicts every test month with the **training coefficients**. The objective is out-of-sample R² = 1 − SSE / SST, where SST uses the training mean as the benchmark.
- **Trade month:** month *t* is priced with the same training coefficients (no refit). Its residual is actual − fitted, and the residual SD comes from the test months.
- **Infeasible parameters** (not enough history, no variables, rank-deficient fit) score `INFEAS` = −1000, so they always lose to any real model.

```{r model}
W_TYPE <- if (WEIGHT_MODE == "simplex") "simplex" else "real"
SPEC_ALL <- data.frame(name = c("Regr_Win", "Z_Win", "Train_MO", "Test_MO", WEIGHTS, "n", "Corr_t"),
                   type = c(rep("int", 4), rep(W_TYPE, length(WEIGHTS)), "nint", "logit"),
                   lo = c(unname(PARAM_MIN[c("Regr_Win", "Z_Win", "Train_MO", "Test_MO")]), rep(NA, length(WEIGHTS)), NA, NA),
                   start = c(pmax(c(36, 12, 24, 6), unname(PARAM_MIN[c("Regr_Win", "Z_Win", "Train_MO", "Test_MO")]) * 1.5), rep(if (W_TYPE == "simplex") 1 / length(WEIGHTS) else 1, length(WEIGHTS)), 5, 0.7),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
SPEC <- SPEC_ALL[!SPEC_ALL$name %in% names(FIXED_PARAMS), , drop = FALSE]      # only these are calibrated
POLISH_PARAMS <- intersect(POLISH_PARAMS, SPEC$name)
I_INT <- which(SPEC$type == "int"); I_REAL <- which(SPEC$type == "real"); I_N <- which(SPEC$type == "nint")
I_LOGIT <- which(SPEC$type == "logit"); I_W <- which(SPEC$type == "simplex"); I_RND <- c(I_INT, I_N); N_RND <- length(I_RND)
U_MIN <- ifelse(SPEC$type == "real", -50, -10); U_MAX <- ifelse(SPEC$type == "real", 50, 10)
add_fixed <- function(th) utils::modifyList(as.list(th), FIXED_PARAMS)        # every parameter set carries the fixed values
clamp_u <- function(u) pmin(pmax(u, U_MIN), U_MAX)

PER_VAR_N <- function(train) if (identical(COMBINE_VARS, "univariate")) Inf else train %/% TRAIN_PER_VAR   # univariate: one variable per regression
n_max_of <- function(W) min(N_RANGE[2], PER_VAR_N(W$train), if (TEST_PER_VAR > 0) W$test %/% TEST_PER_VAR else Inf)
# Calibration ranges from the parameter table (each clamp is skipped when its range is the default, so results are unchanged).
apply_ranges <- function(v) {
  for (i in I_INT) { mx <- PARAM_MAX[SPEC$name[i]]; if (is.finite(mx)) v[i] <- min(v[i], mx) }
  if (length(I_LOGIT) && (CORR_RANGE[1] > 0 || CORR_RANGE[2] < 1)) v[I_LOGIT] <- min(max(v[I_LOGIT], CORR_RANGE[1]), CORR_RANGE[2])
  if (length(I_W)) { wr <- W_RANGE[SPEC$name[I_W], , drop = FALSE]
    if (any(wr[, 1] > 0 | wr[, 2] < 1)) { w <- v[I_W]; for (it in 1:50) { w <- pmin(pmax(w, wr[, 1]), wr[, 2]); w <- w / sum(w) }; v[I_W] <- w } }
  v
}
to_theta <- function(u, U = NULL, n_max = N_RANGE[2]) {
  v <- numeric(length(u))
  x <- SPEC$lo[I_INT] + exp(pmin(u[I_INT], 8))
  xn <- N_RANGE[1] - 0.5 + (n_max - N_RANGE[1] + 1) * plogis(u[I_N])
  if (is.null(U)) { v[I_INT] <- round(x); v[I_N] <- round(xn) } else {
    v[I_INT] <- floor(x + U[seq_along(I_INT)]); v[I_N] <- floor(xn + U[length(I_INT) + 1]) }
  v[I_N] <- min(max(v[I_N], N_RANGE[1]), n_max)
  v[I_REAL] <- u[I_REAL]; v[I_LOGIT] <- plogis(u[I_LOGIT])
  if (length(I_W)) { z <- exp(u[I_W] - max(u[I_W])); v[I_W] <- z / sum(z) }   # softmax: shares >= 0 summing to 1
  v <- apply_ranges(v)
  add_fixed(as.list(setNames(v, SPEC$name)))
}
theta_to_u <- function(th, n_max = N_RANGE[2]) {
  v <- unlist(th[SPEC$name]); u <- numeric(length(v))
  u[I_INT] <- log(pmax(v[I_INT] - SPEC$lo[I_INT], 0.5)); u[I_REAL] <- v[I_REAL]
  u[I_N] <- qlogis(min(max((v[I_N] - N_RANGE[1] + 0.5) / (n_max - N_RANGE[1] + 1), 0.01), 0.99))
  u[I_LOGIT] <- qlogis(min(max(v[I_LOGIT], 0.01), 0.99))
  if (length(I_W)) u[I_W] <- log(pmax(v[I_W], 1e-6))
  clamp_u(u)
}
U_INIT <- theta_to_u(as.list(setNames(SPEC$start, SPEC$name)))
INT_NAMES <- SPEC$name[SPEC$type %in% c("int", "nint")]
round_theta <- function(th, nm) {             # continuous (smoothed) values -> valid model parameters
  th <- as.list(th); for (p in INT_NAMES) th[[p]] <- floor(th[[p]] + 0.5)
  for (i in I_INT) th[[SPEC$name[i]]] <- max(th[[SPEC$name[i]]], SPEC$lo[i])
  vv <- apply_ranges(unlist(th[SPEC$name])); for (k in seq_along(SPEC$name)) th[[SPEC$name[k]]] <- unname(vv[k])
  th <- add_fixed(th)
  if (WEIGHT_MODE == "simplex") { wv <- pmax(unlist(th[WEIGHTS]), 0); if (sum(wv) > 0) th[WEIGHTS] <- as.list(wv / sum(wv)) }
  th$n <- min(max(th$n, N_RANGE[1]), nm); th$Corr_t <- min(max(th$Corr_t, 1e-9), 1 - 1e-9); th
}
req_scores <- function(th) max(th$Regr_Win + th$Z_Win - 1, th$Train_MO + th$Test_MO + th$Z_Win - 1)

score_row <- function(D, th, e) {
  R <- reg_sheet(D, th$Regr_Win); ZR <- zreg_sheet(D, th$Regr_Win, th$Z_Win)
  O <- oos_sheet(D, th$Train_MO, th$Test_MO); ZO <- zoos_sheet(D, th$Train_MO, th$Test_MO, th$Z_Win)
  Lz <- function(z) -log(abs(z) + LOGZ_EPS)
  w <- function(k) if (k %in% WEIGHTS) th[[k]] else 0                 # dropped weights contribute nothing
  sc <- w("b") * R$AdjR2[e, ] + w("d") * Lz(ZR$zA[e, ]) + w("e") * Lz(ZR$zC[e, ]) + w("f") * O[e, ] + w("g") * ZO[e, ]
  if ("a" %in% WEIGHTS) sc <- sc + th$a * R$Pstd[e, ]
  if ("c" %in% WEIGHTS) sc <- sc + th$c * Lz(ZR$zP[e, ])
  sc
}
# Ranking score used by the selection: optionally averaged over past months and filtered for a stable coefficient sign.
score_sel <- function(D, th, e) {
  if (SCORE_AVG_MONTHS <= 1 && SIGN_MIN <= 0 && P_MAX >= 1) return(score_row(D, th, e))   # previous behaviour, exactly
  sc <- if (SCORE_AVG_MONTHS > 1) {
    rows <- max(1, e - SCORE_AVG_MONTHS + 1):e
    S <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rows, function(r) score_row(D, th, r)))
    v <- colMeans(S, na.rm = TRUE); v[colSums(is.finite(S)) < ceiling(length(rows) / 2) | is.na(S[nrow(S), ])] <- NA; v
  } else score_row(D, th, e)
  if (SIGN_MIN > 0) {
    C <- reg_sheet(D, th$Regr_Win)$Coef[max(1, e - SIGN_MONTHS + 1):e, , drop = FALSE]
    same <- colMeans(sign(C) == matrix(sign(C[nrow(C), ]), nrow(C), ncol(C), byrow = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
    sc[!(is.finite(same) & same >= SIGN_MIN)] <- NA
  }
  if (P_MAX < 1) { pv <- reg_sheet(D, th$Regr_Win)$P[e, ]; sc[!(is.finite(pv) & pv < P_MAX)] <- NA }   # own significance now
  sc
}
# VIF of candidate j against the variables already selected (training rows): 1 / (1 - R2 of j on sel)
vif_of <- function(D, rows, others, j) {
  A <- cbind(1, D$X[rows, others, drop = FALSE]); xj <- D$X[rows, j]; ok <- complete.cases(A, xj)
  if (sum(ok) < ncol(A) + 3) return(Inf)
  f <- .lm.fit(A[ok, , drop = FALSE], xj[ok]); sst <- sum((xj[ok] - mean(xj[ok]))^2)
  if (sst <= 0) return(Inf); r2 <- 1 - sum(f$residuals^2) / sst
  if (r2 >= 1) Inf else 1 / (1 - r2)
}
vif_ok <- function(D, rows, sel, j) !is.finite(VIF_MAX) || !length(sel) || vif_of(D, rows, sel, j) <= VIF_MAX
select_vars <- function(D, sc, e, rows, n, corr_t) {
  cand <- order(sc, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  sel <- integer(0); need <- ceiling(MIN_OBS_FRAC * length(rows)); K <- max(4 * n, 30); start <- 1
  fi <- if (length(FORCE_VARS)) { f0 <- match(FORCE_VARS, D$vars); f0[!is.na(f0)] } else integer(0)
  if (length(fi)) {                                            # economic core first (if available in this training window)
    ok_f <- vapply(fi, function(j) !is.na(D$X[rows[length(rows)], j]) && sum(!is.na(D$X[rows, j])) >= need &&
                     isTRUE(var(D$X[rows, j], na.rm = TRUE) > 0), TRUE)
    sel <- head(fi[ok_f], n); cand <- setdiff(cand, fi)
  }
  while (length(sel) < n && start <= length(cand)) {
    blk <- cand[start:min(length(cand), start + K - 1)]; start <- start + K
    Xb <- D$X[rows, blk, drop = FALSE]; ok <- !is.na(D$X[rows[length(rows)], blk]) & colSums(!is.na(Xb)) >= need
    for (j in which(ok)) {
      if (!length(sel)) { if (isTRUE(var(Xb[, j], na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) sel <- blk[j] } else {
        cc <- suppressWarnings(cor(Xb[, j], D$X[rows, sel, drop = FALSE], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
        if (all(is.finite(cc)) && max(abs(cc)) <= corr_t && vif_ok(D, rows, sel, blk[j])) sel <- c(sel, blk[j]) }
      if (length(sel) >= n) break
    }
  }
  sel
}

windows_of <- function(W, m) {
  test_end <- if (TEST_INCLUDES_TRADE_MONTH) m else m - 1
  test <- (test_end - W$test + 1):test_end; e <- test[1] - 1
  list(test = test, e = e, train = (e - W$train + 1):e)
}
feasible_month <- function(W, m) { w <- windows_of(W, m); w$train[1] >= 1 && m <= length(D$y) }

# Rolling linearity check of the model actually used: training rows only (all before the test window, no lookahead).
#  - RESET: does adding fitted^2 and fitted^3 improve the regression? (whole-model misspecification)
#  - per variable: x^2 added to the full regression (F-test, Bonferroni within the model), and the variable swapped for its
#    signed log / signed sqrt (scaled by the median |x| of the training window), compared on adjusted R2
lin_check <- function(D, sel, A, cc, yt, fit) {
  Ac <- A[cc, , drop = FALSE]; y <- yt[cc]; nobs <- nrow(Ac); k <- ncol(Ac); rss0 <- sum(fit$residuals^2); tss <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  ftest <- function(An, q) { f <- .lm.fit(An, y); df2 <- nobs - ncol(An); if (f$rank < ncol(An) || df2 < 1) return(NA_real_)
    rss1 <- sum(f$residuals^2); if (rss1 <= 0) return(NA_real_); pf(((rss0 - rss1) / q) / (rss1 / df2), q, df2, lower.tail = FALSE) }
  adj <- function(rss) 1 - (rss / (nobs - k)) / (tss / (nobs - 1))
  fv <- as.vector(Ac %*% fit$coefficients); s <- sd(fv)
  reset_p <- if (is.finite(s) && s > 0) { z <- (fv - mean(fv)) / s; ftest(cbind(Ac, z^2, z^3), 2) } else NA_real_
  a0 <- adj(rss0)
  vars <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sel), function(i) {
    x <- Ac[, i + 1]; sc <- median(abs(x[x != 0])); if (!is.finite(sc) || sc <= 0) sc <- 1
    sx <- sd(x); p2 <- if (is.finite(sx) && sx > 0) ftest(cbind(Ac, ((x - mean(x)) / sx)^2), 1) else NA_real_
    swap <- function(xt) { An <- Ac; An[, i + 1] <- xt; f <- .lm.fit(An, y); if (f$rank < k) NA_real_ else adj(sum(f$residuals^2)) }
    g <- c(Linear = a0, `Signed log` = swap(slog(x, sc)), `Signed sqrt` = swap(ssqrt(x, sc)))
    best <- names(which.max(g)); gain <- max(g, na.rm = TRUE) - a0
    data.frame(Variable = D$vars[sel[i]], Coef = fit$coefficients[i + 1], P_x2 = p2, Best_form = best, AdjR2_gain = gain,
               Nonlinear = (best != "Linear" && gain >= LIN_GAIN) || (is.finite(p2) && p2 < LIN_P / length(sel)))
  }))
  list(reset_p = reset_p, vars = vars)
}

# Adaptive functional form (TRANSFORM_MODE = "adaptive"): for each selected variable, swap in its signed log / signed sqrt
# (scale = median |x| on the training rows) and keep the form that raises the model's adjusted R2 by >= LIN_GAIN.
# The combined transformed model must also beat the linear one, otherwise everything stays linear. Training rows only.
adapt_forms <- function(sel, A, cc, yt, fit) {
  Ac <- A[cc, , drop = FALSE]; y <- yt[cc]; nobs <- nrow(Ac); k <- ncol(Ac); tss <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  adj <- function(An) { f <- .lm.fit(An, y); if (f$rank < k) NA_real_ else 1 - (sum(f$residuals^2) / (nobs - k)) / (tss / (nobs - 1)) }
  a0 <- 1 - (sum(fit$residuals^2) / (nobs - k)) / (tss / (nobs - 1))
  forms <- rep("Linear", length(sel)); sc <- rep(1, length(sel))
  for (i in seq_along(sel)) {
    x <- Ac[, i + 1]; s0 <- median(abs(x[x != 0])); if (!is.finite(s0) || s0 <= 0) s0 <- 1; sc[i] <- s0
    g <- c(`Signed log` = { An <- Ac; An[, i + 1] <- slog(x, s0); adj(An) }, `Signed sqrt` = { An <- Ac; An[, i + 1] <- ssqrt(x, s0); adj(An) })
    if (any(is.finite(g)) && max(g, na.rm = TRUE) - a0 >= LIN_GAIN) forms[i] <- names(which.max(g))
  }
  if (any(forms != "Linear")) {                                  # joint check: all chosen forms together must beat linear
    An <- Ac; for (i in which(forms != "Linear")) An[, i + 1] <- if (forms[i] == "Signed log") slog(Ac[, i + 1], sc[i]) else ssqrt(Ac[, i + 1], sc[i])
    aj <- adj(An); if (!is.finite(aj) || aj <= a0) forms[] <- "Linear"
  }
  list(forms = forms, sc = sc)
}

# Forecasts for the test months and month m from the selected variables `sel`, with shrinkage and combination.
# Every training window ends at w$e (just before the test window), so nothing after the training data enters a fit.
combo_forecast <- function(D, sel, w, m, X = D$X) {
  rows_out <- c(w$test, m)
  one <- function(tr, cols) {                                   # one regression: forecasts shrunk towards its training mean
    A <- cbind(1, X[tr, cols, drop = FALSE]); yt <- D$y[tr]; cc <- complete.cases(A, yt)
    if (sum(cc) < length(cols) + 3) return(NULL)
    f <- .lm.fit(A[cc, , drop = FALSE], yt[cc]); if (f$rank < ncol(A)) return(NULL)
    p <- as.vector(cbind(1, X[rows_out, cols, drop = FALSE]) %*% f$coefficients); yb <- mean(yt[cc])
    yb + SHRINK * (p - yb)
  }
  avg <- function(L) { L <- Filter(Negate(is.null), L); if (!length(L)) return(NULL)
    M <- do.call(cbind, L); out <- rowMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE); out[!is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_; out }
  per_window <- function(tr) {
    multi <- if (COMBINE_VARS != "univariate") one(tr, sel) else NULL
    uni   <- if (COMBINE_VARS != "none") avg(lapply(sel, function(j) one(tr, j))) else NULL
    if (COMBINE_VARS == "none") multi else if (COMBINE_VARS == "univariate") uni else avg(list(multi, uni))
  }
  lens <- length(w$train)
  if (COMBINE_TRAIN > 0) {
    g <- seq(TRAIN_WIN_RANGE[1], TRAIN_WIN_RANGE[2], TRAIN_WIN_STEP)
    lens <- sort(unique(c(lens, g[abs(g - length(w$train)) <= COMBINE_TRAIN])))
    lens <- lens[w$e - lens + 1 >= 1]                           # only windows with enough history
  }
  P <- avg(lapply(lens, function(L) per_window((w$e - L + 1):w$e)))
  if (is.null(P)) rep(NA_real_, length(rows_out)) else P
}

# Evaluate the nowcast model for parameters th, window pair W, trade month m.
# Fix 2: every infeasible outcome scores INFEAS (far below any real OOS R2).
model_eval <- function(D, th, W, m, detail = FALSE) {
  w <- windows_of(W, m)
  if (w$train[1] < 1) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS - 1))
  rk <- req_scores(th)
  if (w$e < rk) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS - 0.01 * (rk - w$e)))   # windows need more history (slope guides back)
  sel <- select_vars(D, score_sel(D, th, w$e), w$e, w$train, th$n, th$Corr_t)
  if (!length(sel)) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS))
  A <- cbind(1, D$X[w$train, sel, drop = FALSE]); yt <- D$y[w$train]; cc <- complete.cases(A, yt)
  if (sum(cc) < length(sel) + 3) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS))
  fit <- .lm.fit(A[cc, , drop = FALSE], yt[cc]); if (fit$rank < ncol(A)) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS))
  A_raw <- A; fit_raw <- fit; Xsrc <- D$X; cols <- sel; forms <- rep("Linear", length(sel))
  if (TRANSFORM_MODE == "adaptive") {                                               # functional form chosen on the training rows
    af <- adapt_forms(sel, A, cc, yt, fit); forms <- af$forms
    if (any(forms != "Linear")) {
      Xsrc <- D$X[, sel, drop = FALSE]; cols <- seq_along(sel)
      for (i in which(forms != "Linear")) Xsrc[, i] <- if (forms[i] == "Signed log") slog(Xsrc[, i], af$sc[i]) else ssqrt(Xsrc[, i], af$sc[i])
      A <- cbind(1, Xsrc[w$train, , drop = FALSE])
      fit <- .lm.fit(A[cc, , drop = FALSE], yt[cc]); if (fit$rank < ncol(A)) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS))
    }
  }
  b <- fit$coefficients; ybar <- mean(yt[cc])
  yv <- D$y[w$test]
  if (SHRINK == 1 && COMBINE_VARS == "none" && COMBINE_TRAIN <= 0) {                # previous behaviour, exactly
    B <- cbind(1, Xsrc[c(w$test, m), cols, drop = FALSE]); P <- as.vector(B %*% b)
  } else P <- combo_forecast(D, cols, w, m, Xsrc)                                   # forecasts for the test months + month m
  pt <- P[seq_along(w$test)]; ok <- is.finite(pt) & is.finite(yv)
  if (sum(ok) < ceiling(MIN_OBS_FRAC * length(w$test))) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS))
  fv <- pt[ok]; res_test <- yv[ok] - fv
  sst <- sum((yv[ok] - ybar)^2); r2 <- if (sst > 0) 1 - sum(res_test^2) / sst else NA
  if (!is.finite(r2)) return(list(ok = FALSE, obj = INFEAS))
  fitted_m <- if (is.finite(P[length(P)])) P[length(P)] else NA
  out <- list(ok = TRUE, obj = r2, sel = sel, resid = D$y[m] - fitted_m, fitted = fitted_m, actual = D$y[m],
              sigma = sd(res_test), e = w$e, forms = forms)
  if (detail) { s2 <- sum(fit$residuals^2) / (sum(cc) - ncol(A)); se <- sqrt(diag(chol2inv(qr.R(qr(A[cc, , drop = FALSE])))) * s2)
    out$coef <- b[-1]; out$pval <- (2 * pt(-abs(b / se), sum(cc) - ncol(A)))[-1]; out$uni_p <- reg_sheet(D, th$Regr_Win)$P[w$e, sel]
    out$vif <- vapply(seq_along(sel), function(i) if (length(sel) < 2) 1 else vif_of(D, w$train, sel[-i], sel[i]), 0)
    if (HETERO_DIAG) {
      e2 <- fit$residuals^2; Ac <- A[cc, , drop = FALSE]; fb <- .lm.fit(Ac, e2)           # Breusch-Pagan (Koenker): n x R2 of e^2 on X
      r2b <- 1 - sum(fb$residuals^2) / sum((e2 - mean(e2))^2)
      out$bp_stat <- sum(cc) * max(r2b, 0); out$bp_p <- pchisq(out$bp_stat, df = length(sel), lower.tail = FALSE)
      out$var_ratio <- mean(res_test^2) / mean(fit$residuals^2)                              # > 1: errors larger in the test window
    }
    if (TRANSFORM_MODE != "none") out$lin <- lin_check(D, sel, A_raw, cc, yt, fit_raw) }      # check on the linear form of the model
  out
}
```

```{r objective}
# Calibration objective: weighted mean OOS R2 over OBJ_WINDOWS past test windows, all ending at or before month m.
# Window k is the model evaluated as if at month m - k * Test_Win, so the test windows are consecutive and disjoint.
obj_eval <- function(D, th, W, m) {
  e0 <- model_eval(D, th, W, m)
  if (!isTRUE(e0$ok) || OBJ_WINDOWS <= 1) return(e0$obj)              # most recent window must work (keeps INFEAS guidance)
  vals <- e0$obj; wts <- OBJ_RECENT_WEIGHT
  for (k in seq_len(OBJ_WINDOWS - 1)) {
    mk <- m - k * W$test
    if (mk < 1 || windows_of(W, mk)$train[1] < 1) break                 # not enough history for older windows yet
    ek <- model_eval(D, th, W, mk)
    if (isTRUE(ek$ok)) { vals <- c(vals, ek$obj); wts <- c(wts, 1) }
  }
  sum(vals * wts) / sum(wts)
}
```

**Lookahead check.** Selection uses scores at the end of the training window. The fit uses training months only. Test months and month *t* are priced with the training coefficients. Nothing after month *t* is used, and with `TEST_INCLUDES_TRADE_MONTH = FALSE` the calibration objective doesn't even see month *t*.

# 5. Trading engine (Rule 8)

For a signal at month *t*, the residual is actual − fitted:
- **Direction:** a positive residual means overpriced, so SELL; a negative residual means BUY.
- **Entry:** only if |residual| > `Min_Res` × SD(test residuals), on the entry day set by `ENTRY_DAY`.
- **Exits:** TP = 1 × |residual| and SL = 1 × |residual| (fixed, `FIXED_T` / `FIXED_S`), checked against the cumulative trade return at each daily close. Otherwise the trade exits after `MAX_HOLD_M` months.
- **Sleeves:** each trade uses 1/`MAX_HOLD_M` of equity. The portfolio holds the net exposure, and 10 bps is charged per side on exposure changes.

```{r trading}
sim_trades <- function(D, entry, dir, TP, SL, cutoff) {
  N <- length(entry); lim <- pmin(D$mh_idx[entry], cutoff, D$n_days); H <- max(c(0, lim - entry))
  pos <- lim - entry; reason <- character(N); hitTP_at <- logical(N); anyhit <- logical(N)
  if (H >= 1) {
    idx <- outer(seq_len(H), entry, "+"); valid <- idx <= rep(lim, each = H); idx <- pmin(idx, rep(lim, each = H))
    dR <- (exp(D$L[idx] - rep(D$L[entry], each = H)) - 1) * rep(dir, each = H)
    hTP <- valid & dR >= rep(TP, each = H); hSL <- valid & dR <= -rep(SL, each = H)
    hit <- matrix(hTP | hSL, H, N); anyhit <- colSums(hit) > 0
    first <- max.col(t(hit) * 1, ties.method = "first"); pos[anyhit] <- first[anyhit]
    hitTP_at <- matrix(hTP, H, N)[cbind(pmax(first, 1), seq_len(N))] & anyhit
  }
  exit <- entry + pos; reason[anyhit] <- ifelse(hitTP_at[anyhit], "TP", "SL"); nh <- !anyhit
  reason[nh] <- ifelse(lim[nh] == D$mh_idx[entry[nh]] & D$mh_full[entry[nh]], "MaxHold", ifelse(lim[nh] == cutoff, "Open", "EndOfData"))
  list(exit = exit, gross = dir * (exp(D$L[exit] - D$L[entry]) - 1), reason = reason)
}
port_returns <- function(D, entry, exit, dir, from, to) {
  nd <- to - from + 1; w <- dir / MAX_HOLD_M
  ag <- rowsum(c(w, -w), c(entry, exit) - from + 1); dE <- numeric(nd); dE[as.integer(rownames(ag))] <- ag[, 1]
  E <- round(cumsum(dE), 12); Ep <- c(0, E[-nd]); Ep * D$r[from:to] - COST_PER_SIDE * abs(E - Ep)
}
ret_x_sharpe <- function(rp) {                 # return x Sharpe; any losing combination scores its (negative) return
  if (!length(rp)) return(0); mu <- mean(rp); R <- mu * 252; s <- sd(rp)
  S <- if (is.finite(s) && s > 1e-12) mu / s * sqrt(252) else 0
  if (R > 0 && S > 0) R * S else R
}
```

**Lookahead check.** Entry is always after the signal month closes. When trade rules are calibrated, past trades are marked to market at month *t*'s close.

# 6. Calibration

**Monthly: model parameters.** Every month, Nesterov-accelerated SPSA calibrates the regression, z-score and OOS windows, the weights a–g, `n` and `Corr_t` to maximise the nowcast's out-of-sample R², starting from several points in parallel.

- **Starts (fix 5):** the default point, random points around it, and last month's calibrated parameters (as an extra candidate; the final choice is still purely the highest objective).
- **Best-ever tracking (fix 3):** every evaluation, including the ± perturbation probes, is a candidate. The exact parameter set (with its rounding) that produced the best value is kept.
- **Local polish (fix 4):** starting from the SPSA winner, `n` is searched over all allowed values, and `Corr_t`, the four windows and the weights a–g are moved in small steps, one at a time, keeping any improvement. This repeats until nothing improves (at most `POLISH_ROUNDS` passes).
- **Smoothing (optional):** each calibrated parameter, window and weight is smoothed as set in the parameter table (`SMOOTH_TABLE`: method and months per row). With `SMOOTHING = "none"` the used parameters are exactly the calibrated ones.

**Window pair (fix 6).** Every month (`WINDOW_UPDATE = "monthly"`) or every January:

1. **Screen:** all (`Train_Win`, `Test_Win`) pairs on the grid are scored by their OOS R², averaged over the last `WINDOW_SCORE_MONTHS` months, using the current parameters.
2. **Joint calibration:** the top `WINDOW_TOP_K` pairs, plus the pair currently in use, each get the full parameter calibration above for this month.
3. **Choice:** the pair with the highest calibrated OOS R² is used, together with its parameters.

OOS R² from different test-window lengths isn't strictly comparable: a shorter test window is noisier and easier to fit, so this step leans towards shorter test windows.

**Monthly: trade rule.** TP and SL are fixed at 1 × |residual|. After the model is set, only `Min_Res` is chosen on a grid (0 to 0.6 × residual SD, steps of 0.05) to maximise return × Sharpe of the signals from the current test window. A losing value scores its negative return.

```{r calibration}
# Fix 3: Nesterov-SPSA that keeps the best parameter set from EVERY evaluation (probes included).
nag <- function(f, u0, B, th_of) {
  u <- u0; v <- numeric(length(u))
  best <- list(f = f(u), u = u, th = th_of(u, NULL))
  keep <- function(val, uu, U) if (is.finite(val) && val > best$f) best <<- list(f = val, u = uu, th = th_of(uu, U))
  for (it in seq_len(B$iters)) {
    ck <- NAG_C0 / it^0.101; ak <- NAG_A0 / it^0.602; y <- u + NAG_MU * v; g <- numeric(length(u))
    for (p in seq_len(B$n_pert)) {
      Dl <- sample(c(-1, 1), length(u), TRUE); U <- runif(N_RND)
      up <- clamp_u(y + ck * Dl); dn <- clamp_u(y - ck * Dl)
      fp <- f(up, U); fm <- f(dn, U); keep(fp, up, U); keep(fm, dn, U)
      g <- g + (fp - fm) / (2 * ck) * Dl
    }
    rms <- sqrt(mean(g^2))
    v <- pmax(pmin(NAG_MU * v + ak * (if (rms > 1e-12) g / rms else 0), NAG_VMAX), -NAG_VMAX)
    u <- clamp_u(u + v); keep(f(u), u, NULL)
  }
  best
}

# Fix 4: deterministic local polish in parameter space (coordinate search, keeps any improvement).
polish <- function(D, th, W, m, nm, obj_th) {
  best_th <- th; best_f <- obj_th(th)
  if (POLISH_ROUNDS < 1) return(best_th)
  w_lo <- -50; w_hi <- 50
  for (r in seq_len(POLISH_ROUNDS)) {
    improved <- FALSE
    for (p in POLISH_PARAMS) {
      cur <- best_th[[p]]
      cand <- if (p == "n") N_RANGE[1]:nm
        else if (p == "Corr_t") pmin(pmax(cur + c(-0.10, -0.05, 0.05, 0.10), 0.05), 0.99)
        else if (p %in% WEIGHTS && WEIGHT_MODE == "simplex") pmax(c(0, 0.5 * cur, 2 * cur, cur - 0.1, cur + 0.1), 0)
        else if (p %in% WEIGHTS) pmin(pmax(c(0, 0.5 * cur, 2 * cur, -cur, cur - 0.5, cur + 0.5), w_lo), w_hi)
        else { lo <- SPEC$lo[SPEC$name == p]; st <- max(1, round(0.05 * cur)); v <- cur + c(-2, -1, 1, 2) * st; v[v >= lo] }
      for (v in setdiff(unique(cand), cur)) {
        th2 <- best_th; th2[[p]] <- v
        if (p %in% WEIGHTS && WEIGHT_MODE == "simplex") { tot <- sum(unlist(th2[WEIGHTS])); if (tot <= 0) next
          th2[WEIGHTS] <- as.list(unlist(th2[WEIGHTS]) / tot) }                    # keep shares summing to 1
        f2 <- obj_th(th2)
        if (is.finite(f2) && f2 > best_f + 1e-12) { best_f <- f2; best_th <- th2; improved <- TRUE }
      }
    }
    if (!improved) break
  }
  best_th
}

# Fixes 3, 4, 5 combined. th_prev = last month's calibrated parameters (added as an extra start).
calibrate_model <- function(D, m, W, u_warm, u_anchor, seed, th_prev = NULL) {
  nm <- n_max_of(W)
  th_of <- function(u, U) to_theta(u, U, nm)
  f <- function(u, U = NULL) obj_eval(D, th_of(u, U), W, m)                     # multi-window objective
  obj_th <- function(th) obj_eval(D, th, W, m)
  set.seed(seed)
  spread <- if (WARM_START) 0.7 else 1.0
  u_prev <- if (!is.null(th_prev)) theta_to_u(round_theta(th_prev, nm), nm) else NULL
  starts <- c(list(u_warm), if (!is.null(u_prev)) list(u_prev),
              lapply(seq_len(max(0, CAL$starts - 1)), function(i) clamp_u(u_warm + rnorm(length(u_warm), 0, spread))))
  res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_along(starts), function(i) { set.seed(seed + i); nag(f, starts[[i]], CAL, th_of) },
                            mc.cores = min(N_CORES, length(starts)), mc.preschedule = FALSE)
  if (any(vapply(res, inherits, TRUE, what = "try-error"))) stop("Worker error in calibration at month ", m)
  best <- res[[which.max(vapply(res, `[[`, 0, "f"))]]
  th <- polish(D, best$th, W, m, nm, obj_th)
  cands <- c(list(th), lapply(res, `[[`, "th"))                     # winner (polished) first, then each start's best
  ev <- model_eval(D, th, W, m)
  objm <- obj_eval(D, th, W, m)
  list(u = theta_to_u(th, nm), th = th, obj = if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$obj else NA_real_,       # most recent window (reported as OOS R2)
       objm = if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) objm else NA_real_,                                         # multi-window objective (used for choices)
       cands = cands)                                                                        # candidate parameter sets (validation mode)
}

WIN_GRID <- expand.grid(train = seq(TRAIN_WIN_RANGE[1], TRAIN_WIN_RANGE[2], TRAIN_WIN_STEP),
                        test = seq(TEST_WIN_RANGE[1], TEST_WIN_RANGE[2], TEST_WIN_STEP))
snap_win <- function(x, rng, step) min(max(rng[1] + round((x - rng[1]) / step) * step, rng[1]), rng[2])   # nearest grid value
win_dist2 <- function(a, b) (((a$train - b$train) / max(diff(TRAIN_WIN_RANGE), 1))^2 + ((a$test - b$test) / max(diff(TEST_WIN_RANGE), 1))^2) / 2   # safe if a range is fixed
# Screen: returns the top_k window pairs (list, best first) by average OOS R2 over the last WINDOW_SCORE_MONTHS months.
choose_windows <- function(D, m, th, top_k = 1) {
  sc <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(WIN_GRID)), function(i) {
    W <- list(train = WIN_GRID$train[i], test = WIN_GRID$test[i]); th2 <- round_theta(th, n_max_of(W))
    js <- max(1, m - WINDOW_SCORE_MONTHS + 1):m; js <- js[vapply(js, function(j) windows_of(W, j)$train[1] >= 1, TRUE)]
    if (!length(js)) return(NA_real_)
    v <- vapply(js, function(j) { ev <- model_eval(D, th2, W, j); if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$obj else NA_real_ }, 0); v <- v[!is.na(v)]
    if (!length(v)) NA_real_ else mean(v)
  }, mc.cores = N_CORES)
  sc <- unlist(sc); if (all(is.na(sc))) return(list())
  o <- order(sc, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA); o <- o[seq_len(min(top_k, length(o)))]
  lapply(o, function(i) list(train = WIN_GRID$train[i], test = WIN_GRID$test[i], score = sc[i]))
}

calib_trade_rules <- function(D, sig, m, W, prev) {
  cutoff <- D$last_day[m]; w <- windows_of(W, m); months <- setdiff(w$test, m)
  s <- sig[sig$k %in% months & !is.na(sig$entry) & sig$entry < cutoff, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(s) < MIN_SIGNALS_FOR_TRADE_CALIB) return(list(rules = DEFAULT_TRADE_RULES, obj = NA, n = nrow(s)))
  from <- min(s$entry); nd <- cutoff - from + 1; r <- D$r[from:cutoff]; ar <- abs(s$resid)
  nT <- length(T_GRID); nS <- length(S_GRID); ET <- matrix(Inf, nrow(s), nT); ES <- matrix(Inf, nrow(s), nS); LEN <- integer(nrow(s))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
    e <- s$entry[i]; lim <- min(D$mh_idx[e], cutoff)
    if (lim <= e) next
    pnl <- s$dir[i] * (exp(D$L[(e + 1):lim] - D$L[e]) - 1); LEN[i] <- length(pnl)
    ET[i, ] <- findInterval(T_GRID * ar[i], cummax(pnl), left.open = TRUE) + 1
    ES[i, ] <- findInterval(S_GRID * ar[i], -cummin(pnl), left.open = TRUE) + 1
  }
  w8 <- s$dir / MAX_HOLD_M; O <- array(NA_real_, c(nT, nS, length(MINRES_GRID)))
  for (a in seq_len(nT)) for (b in seq_len(nS)) {
    ex <- s$entry + pmin(ET[, a], ES[, b], LEN)
    for (k in seq_along(MINRES_GRID)) {
      inc <- ar > MINRES_GRID[k] * s$sigma
      if (!any(inc)) { O[a, b, k] <- 0; next }
      ag <- rowsum(c(w8[inc], -w8[inc]), c(s$entry[inc], ex[inc]) - from + 1)
      dE <- numeric(nd); dE[as.integer(rownames(ag))] <- ag[, 1]
      E <- round(cumsum(dE), 12); Ep <- c(0, E[-nd]); O[a, b, k] <- ret_x_sharpe(Ep * r - COST_PER_SIDE * abs(E - Ep))
    }
  }
  score <- O
  i <- arrayInd(which.max(score), dim(score))
  list(rules = c(t = T_GRID[i[1]], s = S_GRID[i[2]], min_res = MINRES_GRID[i[3]]), obj = O[i], n = nrow(s))
}
ema <- function(prev, new, N) if (is.null(prev) || !LAYER2) new else prev + 2 / (N + 1) * (new - prev)
roll_stat <- function(v, how) { v <- v[is.finite(v)]; if (!length(v)) return(NA_real_)
  switch(how, median = median(v), mean = mean(v), midrange = (min(v) + max(v)) / 2, midhinge = mean(quantile(v, c(0.25, 0.75), names = FALSE)),
         stop("Unknown smoothing statistic: ", how)) }
SMOOTH_METHODS <- c("none", "ema", "mean", "median", "mode", "midrange", "midhinge")
SMOOTH_NAMES   <- c("Regr_Win", "Z_Win", "Train_MO", "Test_MO", "n", "Corr_t", letters[1:7], "Min_Res", "Train_Win", "Test_Win")
SMOOTH_SPEC <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(SMOOTH_TABLE)), function(i)
  list(method = trimws(SMOOTH_TABLE$method[i]), months = as.numeric(SMOOTH_TABLE$months[i]))), trimws(SMOOTH_TABLE$name))
local({
  bad <- setdiff(names(SMOOTH_SPEC), SMOOTH_NAMES)
  if (length(bad)) stop("Parameter table: unknown name(s) ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "), " (use ", paste(SMOOTH_NAMES, collapse = ", "), ")")
  badm <- names(SMOOTH_SPEC)[!vapply(SMOOTH_SPEC, function(x) x$method %in% SMOOTH_METHODS, TRUE)]
  if (length(badm)) stop("Parameter table: unknown method for ", paste(badm, collapse = ", "), " (use ", paste(SMOOTH_METHODS, collapse = ", "), ")")
  ne <- names(SMOOTH_SPEC)[vapply(SMOOTH_SPEC, function(x) x$method == "ema" && !is.finite(x$months), TRUE)]
  if (length(ne)) stop("Parameter table: 'ema' needs a number of months for ", paste(ne, collapse = ", "))
  fx <- intersect(names(SMOOTH_SPEC), c(names(FIXED_PARAMS), setdiff(letters[1:7], WEIGHTS)))
  if (length(fx)) message("Parameter table: no effect for ", paste(fx, collapse = ", "), " (fixed in FIXED_PARAMS or not in WEIGHTS)")
  if (!LAYER2) message("SMOOTHING = 'none': every parameter is used raw")
})
mode_stat <- function(h) { h <- h[is.finite(h)]; if (!length(h)) return(NA_real_); tb <- table(h); top <- as.numeric(names(tb)[tb == max(tb)])
  if (length(top) == 1) return(top); d <- abs(top - median(h)); top <- top[d == min(d)]; if (length(top) == 1) return(top)
  for (v in rev(h)) if (v %in% top) return(v) }
# Smoothing of one parameter / window, as set in the parameter table (no row, or SMOOTHING = "none" -> raw value).
# prev = last smoothed value; hist = raw values up to and including this month.
smooth_one <- function(name, prev, hist) {
  new <- hist[length(hist)]; sp <- SMOOTH_SPEC[[name]]
  if (!LAYER2 || is.null(sp) || sp$method == "none") return(new)
  if (sp$method == "ema") return(ema(prev, new, sp$months))
  h <- tail(hist, if (is.finite(sp$months)) sp$months else Inf)
  if (sp$method == "mode") mode_stat(h) else roll_stat(h, sp$method)
}

# ---- 2-state Gaussian Markov model on a 1-column score, fitted by EM on the rows it is given ----
# Returns the FILTERED probability of the "bad" state at the last row (uses rows 1..T only; never smoothed).
hmm2_filter <- function(X) {
  Z <- scale(as.matrix(X)); Tn <- nrow(Z); K <- ncol(Z); sc <- rowSums(Z); g <- sc > median(sc)   # init: above-median score = good
  mu <- rbind(colMeans(Z[!g, , drop = FALSE]), colMeans(Z[g, , drop = FALSE]))
  sdv <- rbind(apply(Z[!g, , drop = FALSE], 2, sd), apply(Z[g, , drop = FALSE], 2, sd)); sdv[!is.finite(sdv) | sdv < 0.1] <- 0.5
  P <- matrix(c(0.9, 0.1, 0.1, 0.9), 2, byrow = TRUE); pi0 <- c(0.5, 0.5)
  emis <- function() { L <- sapply(1:2, function(k) rowSums(dnorm(Z, matrix(mu[k, ], Tn, K, byrow = TRUE),
                                                                   matrix(sdv[k, ], Tn, K, byrow = TRUE), log = TRUE)))
                       exp(L - apply(L, 1, max)) }                                     # per-row scaling cancels in filtering
  fwd <- function(B) { a <- matrix(0, Tn, 2); a[1, ] <- pi0 * B[1, ]; a[1, ] <- a[1, ] / sum(a[1, ])
    for (t in 2:Tn) { v <- (a[t - 1, ] %*% P) * B[t, ]; a[t, ] <- v / sum(v) }; a }
  for (it in seq_len(MK_ITERS)) {
    B <- emis(); a <- fwd(B); b <- matrix(1, Tn, 2)
    for (t in (Tn - 1):1) { v <- P %*% (B[t + 1, ] * b[t + 1, ]); b[t, ] <- v / sum(v) }
    gm <- a * b; gm <- gm / rowSums(gm); xi <- matrix(0, 2, 2)
    for (t in 1:(Tn - 1)) { m2 <- outer(a[t, ], B[t + 1, ] * b[t + 1, ]) * P; xi <- xi + m2 / sum(m2) }
    P <- pmax(xi / rowSums(xi), 1e-3); P <- P / rowSums(P); pi0 <- gm[1, ]
    for (k in 1:2) { w <- gm[, k] / sum(gm[, k]); mu[k, ] <- colSums(w * Z); sdv[k, ] <- pmax(sqrt(colSums(w * (Z - matrix(mu[k, ], Tn, K, byrow = TRUE))^2)), 0.1) }
  }
  a <- fwd(emis()); bad <- which.min(rowSums(mu))                                   # bad = the low-score state
  list(p_bad = a[Tn, bad], stay_bad = P[bad, bad], stay_good = P[3 - bad, 3 - bad])
}
# ---- K-state Gaussian Markov model (diagonal covariance), EM on the rows given; returns FILTERED probabilities for every row ----
hmmK_filter <- function(Z, K) {
  Z <- as.matrix(Z); Tn <- nrow(Z); D2 <- ncol(Z)
  g <- cut(rank(Z[, min(2, D2)], ties.method = "first"), K, labels = FALSE)       # init: split on the volatility column
  mu <- t(sapply(1:K, function(k) colMeans(Z[g == k, , drop = FALSE])))
  sdv <- t(sapply(1:K, function(k) apply(Z[g == k, , drop = FALSE], 2, sd))); sdv[!is.finite(sdv) | sdv < 0.1] <- 0.5
  if (D2 == 1) { mu <- matrix(mu, K, 1); sdv <- matrix(sdv, K, 1) }
  P <- matrix(0.1 / (K - 1), K, K); diag(P) <- 0.9; pi0 <- rep(1 / K, K)
  emis <- function() { L <- sapply(1:K, function(k) rowSums(dnorm(Z, matrix(mu[k, ], Tn, D2, byrow = TRUE),
                                                                   matrix(sdv[k, ], Tn, D2, byrow = TRUE), log = TRUE)))
                       exp(L - apply(L, 1, max)) }
  fwd <- function(B) { a <- matrix(0, Tn, K); a[1, ] <- pi0 * B[1, ]; a[1, ] <- a[1, ] / sum(a[1, ])
    for (t in 2:Tn) { v <- (a[t - 1, ] %*% P) * B[t, ]; a[t, ] <- v / sum(v) }; a }
  for (it in seq_len(MK_ITERS)) {
    B <- emis(); a <- fwd(B); b <- matrix(1, Tn, K)
    for (t in (Tn - 1):1) { v <- P %*% (B[t + 1, ] * b[t + 1, ]); b[t, ] <- v / sum(v) }
    gm <- a * b; gm <- gm / rowSums(gm); xi <- matrix(0, K, K)
    for (t in 1:(Tn - 1)) { m2 <- outer(a[t, ], B[t + 1, ] * b[t + 1, ]) * P; xi <- xi + m2 / sum(m2) }
    P <- pmax(xi / rowSums(xi), 1e-3); P <- P / rowSums(P); pi0 <- gm[1, ]
    for (k in 1:K) { w <- gm[, k] / sum(gm[, k]); mu[k, ] <- colSums(w * Z)
      sdv[k, ] <- pmax(sqrt(colSums(w * (Z - matrix(mu[k, ], Tn, D2, byrow = TRUE))^2)), 0.1) }
  }
  list(alpha = fwd(emis()), stay = diag(P))
}
# hmm3 state for month m. H = inputs (variance ratio, volatility, R2 slope) for the months in `months`, all <= m.
markov3_state <- function(H, months, decs, m) {
  out <- list(p_bad = NA_real_, state = 1L, regime = NA_character_, worst = NA_character_, score = NA_real_, thr = NA_real_)
  if (any(is.na(H[nrow(H), ]))) return(out)
  ok <- complete.cases(H); Hc <- H[ok, , drop = FALSE]; mc <- months[ok]
  if (is.finite(MK_HIST_WIN) && nrow(Hc) > MK_HIST_WIN) { kp <- (nrow(Hc) - MK_HIST_WIN + 1):nrow(Hc); Hc <- Hc[kp, , drop = FALSE]; mc <- mc[kp] }
  if (nrow(Hc) < MK_MIN_HIST || any(apply(Hc, 2, sd) <= 0)) return(out)
  f <- tryCatch(hmmK_filter(scale(Hc), 3), error = function(e) NULL); if (is.null(f)) return(out)
  vmean <- sapply(1:3, function(k) weighted.mean(Hc[, 2], f$alpha[, k]))          # name states by volatility (stable across refits)
  LBL <- if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") c("low", "mid", "high") else c("calm", "normal", "turbulent")   # named by column 2 (VR or volatility)
  BADR <- if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") MK_BAD_REGIME_B else MK_BAD_REGIME
  nm3 <- LBL[rank(vmean, ties.method = "first")]
  sh <- max.col(f$alpha, ties.method = "first"); cur <- sh[length(sh)]
  worst <- NA_integer_
  dl <- if (identical(BADR, "learned")) Filter(function(x) isTRUE(x$trade) && x$m < m && x$m %in% mc, decs) else list()        # past trades, ranked only if CLOSED by month m's close
  if (length(dl)) {
    ent <- vapply(dl, function(x) D$entry_idx[x$m], 0); dir <- vapply(dl, function(x) -sign(x$ev$resid), 0)
    TPv <- vapply(dl, function(x) x$tr[["t"]] * abs(x$ev$resid), 0); SLv <- vapply(dl, function(x) x$tr[["s"]] * abs(x$ev$resid), 0)
    st <- sim_trades(D, ent, dir, TPv, SLv, D$last_day[m])
    closed <- st$reason %in% c("TP", "SL", "MaxHold"); ret <- st$gross - 2 * COST_PER_SIDE
    sk <- sh[match(vapply(dl, function(x) x$m, 0), mc)]
    avg <- sapply(1:3, function(k) { s <- closed & sk == k; if (sum(s) >= MK_MIN_TRADES) mean(ret[s]) else NA_real_ })
    if (sum(is.finite(avg)) >= 2 && min(avg, na.rm = TRUE) < MK_BAD_BELOW) worst <- which.min(avg)   # only a regime that actually lost
  }
  if (!identical(BADR, "learned")) {                                                # fixed in advance: no dependence on trade outcomes
    bad_now <- nm3[cur] %in% BADR
    return(list(p_bad = sum(f$alpha[nrow(f$alpha), nm3 %in% BADR]), state = if (bad_now) 0L else 1L, regime = nm3[cur],
                worst = paste(BADR, collapse = "+"), score = NA_real_, thr = NA_real_, stay = f$stay[order(vmean)]))
  }
  list(p_bad = if (is.na(worst)) NA_real_ else f$alpha[nrow(f$alpha), worst], state = if (!is.na(worst) && cur == worst) 0L else 1L,
       regime = nm3[cur], worst = if (is.na(worst)) NA_character_ else nm3[worst], score = NA_real_, thr = NA_real_,
       stay = f$stay[order(vmean)])
}
# Binary state with hysteresis. H = all monthly inputs up to and including month t; prev = last month's state.
markov_state <- function(H, prev) {
  out <- list(p_bad = NA_real_, state = prev, stay_bad = NA_real_, stay_good = NA_real_, score = NA_real_)
  if (is.null(H) || any(is.na(H[nrow(H), ]))) return(out)                           # no inputs this month: keep the state
  Hc <- H[complete.cases(H), , drop = FALSE]
  if (is.finite(MK_HIST_WIN) && nrow(Hc) > MK_HIST_WIN) Hc <- Hc[(nrow(Hc) - MK_HIST_WIN + 1):nrow(Hc), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(Hc) < MK_MIN_HIST || any(apply(Hc, 2, sd) <= 0)) { out$state <- 1L; return(out) }
  score <- matrix(rowSums(scale(Hc)), ncol = 1)               # combined score: z(log2 variance ratio) + z(OOS R2), standardised on history only
  if (MK_METHOD == "threshold") {                             # quantile of the score history (up to and including month t)
    thr <- unname(quantile(score[, 1], MK_QUANTILE)); sc_t <- score[nrow(score), 1]
    return(list(p_bad = as.numeric(sc_t < thr), state = if (sc_t < thr) 0L else 1L, stay_bad = NA_real_, stay_good = NA_real_,
                score = sc_t, thr = thr))
  }
  f <- tryCatch(hmm2_filter(score), error = function(e) NULL); if (is.null(f) || !is.finite(f$p_bad)) return(out)
  st <- if (prev == 1L && f$p_bad > MK_ENTER) 0L else if (prev == 0L && f$p_bad < MK_EXIT) 1L else prev
  list(p_bad = f$p_bad, state = st, stay_bad = f$stay_bad, stay_good = f$stay_good, score = score[nrow(score), 1])
}
```

**Lookahead check.** Every objective at month *t* uses data up to *t* − 1 (or *t* with `TEST_INCLUDES_TRADE_MONTH = TRUE`). Past trades are marked to market at *t*'s close. The window screen and the joint calibration only use months up to *t*. The moving averages only use past calibrations.

# 7. Lookahead tests

Each step is recomputed on data truncated at month *k* and must match the full-data result exactly.

```{r lookahead-tests}
th0 <- to_theta(U_INIT); W0 <- list(train = TRAIN_WIN_RANGE[1], test = TEST_WIN_RANGE[1])
k_test <- max(W0$train + W0$test + 14, floor(D$Tn * 0.6))
TRc <- truncate_inputs(MON, DAY, k_test); Dt <- make_data(TRc$MON, TRc$DAY)
same <- function(a, b) isTRUE(all.equal(a[seq_len(nrow(b)), , drop = FALSE], b, tolerance = 1e-9))
e_full <- model_eval(D, th0, W0, k_test, TRUE); e_tr <- model_eval(Dt, th0, W0, k_test, TRUE)
sig0 <- do.call(rbind, lapply((k_test - W0$test):(k_test - 1), function(j) { ev <- model_eval(D, th0, W0, j)
  if (!ev$ok || !is.finite(ev$resid)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(k = j, entry = D$entry_idx[j], dir = -sign(ev$resid), resid = ev$resid, sigma = ev$sigma) }))
LA <- data.frame(
  Step = c("P values, standardized P, adj. R2, coefficients", "Z-scores", "Per-variable OOS R2 and its z-score",
           "Selection + nowcast + OOS R2 objective + residual", "Trade-rule calibration (Min_Res; TP/SL fixed)",
           "Multi-window calibration objective", "Validation-window evaluation",
           "Transforms, VIF, heteroskedasticity and rolling linearity diagnostics", "Markov state (history up to t only, deterministic)"),
  Pass = c(all(mapply(same, reg_sheet(D, th0$Regr_Win), reg_sheet(Dt, th0$Regr_Win))),
           all(mapply(same, zreg_sheet(D, th0$Regr_Win, th0$Z_Win), zreg_sheet(Dt, th0$Regr_Win, th0$Z_Win))),
           same(oos_sheet(D, th0$Train_MO, th0$Test_MO), oos_sheet(Dt, th0$Train_MO, th0$Test_MO)) &&
             same(zoos_sheet(D, th0$Train_MO, th0$Test_MO, th0$Z_Win), zoos_sheet(Dt, th0$Train_MO, th0$Test_MO, th0$Z_Win)),
           identical(e_full$sel, e_tr$sel) && isTRUE(all.equal(e_full[c("obj", "resid", "sigma")], e_tr[c("obj", "resid", "sigma")])),
           is.null(sig0) || isTRUE(all.equal(calib_trade_rules(D, sig0, k_test, W0, NULL), calib_trade_rules(Dt, sig0, k_test, W0, NULL))),
           isTRUE(all.equal(obj_eval(D, th0, W0, k_test), obj_eval(Dt, th0, W0, k_test))),
           isTRUE(all.equal(model_eval(D, th0, list(train = W0$train, test = VAL_WIN), k_test)[c("obj", "resid")],
                            model_eval(Dt, th0, list(train = W0$train, test = VAL_WIN), k_test)[c("obj", "resid")])),
           same(D$X, Dt$X) && isTRUE(all.equal(e_full[c("vif", "bp_stat", "var_ratio", "lin")], e_tr[c("vif", "bp_stat", "var_ratio", "lin")])),
           local({ set.seed(1); Hx <- cbind(rnorm(80), rnorm(80)); a1 <- markov_state(Hx[1:60, ], 1L); a2 <- markov_state(Hx[1:60, ], 1L)
                   isTRUE(all.equal(a1, a2)) && is.finite(a1$p_bad) &&
                   { f1 <- hmmK_filter(scale(Hx[1:60, ]), 3); f2 <- hmmK_filter(scale(Hx[1:60, ]), 3); isTRUE(all.equal(f1, f2)) } })))
LA$Result <- ifelse(LA$Pass, "PASS", "FAIL"); LA[, c("Step", "Result")]
if (!all(LA$Pass)) stop("Lookahead test failed - stopping.")
rm(Dt, TRc)
```

# 8. Benchmark

```{r benchmark}
m_b <- min(D$Tn, max(W0$train + W0$test + 30, floor(D$Tn * 0.7)))
t_eval <- system.time(for (i in 1:20) model_eval(D, to_theta(U_INIT + rnorm(length(U_INIT), 0, 0.1), runif(N_RND)), W0, m_b))[["elapsed"]] / 20
t_cal  <- system.time(calibrate_model(D, m_b, W0, U_INIT, U_INIT, 1, th0))[["elapsed"]]
t_win  <- system.time(choose_windows(D, m_b, th0, WINDOW_TOP_K))[["elapsed"]]
n_months <- D$Tn - (W0$train + W0$test); n_years <- ceiling(n_months / 12)
n_upd <- if (WINDOW_UPDATE == "monthly") n_months else n_years          # window screens
n_cal <- if (WINDOW_UPDATE == "monthly") n_months * (WINDOW_TOP_K + 1) else n_months + n_years * WINDOW_TOP_K   # calibrations (upper bound)
proj <- (n_cal * t_cal + n_months + n_upd * t_win) / 3600
data.frame(Measure = c("One model evaluation", "One calibration (SPSA + polish)", "One window screen",
                       "Months to calibrate", "Calibrations (upper bound)", "Projected total"),
           Value = c(sprintf("%.1f ms", 1000 * t_eval), sprintf("%.1f s", t_cal), sprintf("%.1f s", t_win), n_months, n_cal,
                     sprintf("%.1f h (likely range %.1f - %.1f h)", proj, 0.7 * proj, 2 * proj)))
```

# 9. Monthly backtest

Progress is written to `progress.log` in the results folder, and a checkpoint is saved every 12 months, so knitting again resumes where it stopped.

```{r backtest, message=NA}
CK_FILE <- file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("checkpoint_%s.rds", if (QUICK_MODE) "quick" else "full"))
SIGNATURE <- paste("v3fix", STOCK, DAILY_FILE, Y_FROM_DAILY, QUICK_MODE, ENTRY_DAY, COST_PER_SIDE, MAX_HOLD_M, D$Tn, D$V, signif(sum(D$y, na.rm = TRUE), 10), nrow(DAY),
                   TRAIN_WIN_RANGE, TRAIN_WIN_STEP, TEST_WIN_RANGE, TEST_WIN_STEP, TRAIN_PER_VAR, TEST_PER_VAR, N_RANGE,
                   WINDOW_SCORE_MONTHS, WINDOW_UPDATE, WINDOW_TOP_K, TEST_INCLUDES_TRADE_MONTH, SMOOTHING, "table", paste(deparse(SMOOTH_SPEC), collapse = ""),
                   WARM_START, INFEAS, POLISH_ROUNDS, POLISH_PARAMS, "force", FORCE_VARS, PARAM_MIN, "stable", SCORE_AVG_MONTHS, SIGN_MIN, SIGN_MONTHS, "pmax", P_MAX, "ranges", PARAM_MIN, PARAM_MAX, N_RANGE, CORR_RANGE, W_RANGE, MINRES_GRID, WEIGHTS, P_TRANSFORM, WEIGHT_MODE, VIF_MAX, HETERO_DIAG, TRANSFORM_MODE, MARKOV_MODE, MK_METHOD, MK_VOL_MONTHS, MK_SLOPE_MONTHS, MK_MIN_TRADES, MK_BAD_BELOW, MK_BAD_REGIME, MK_DEV_MONTHS, MK_INPUT1, MK_B_SLOPE_MONTHS, MK_BAD_REGIME_B, COMBINED_STRATEGY, COMBINED_MARKOV, MK_ENS_WINDOWS, MK_CALM_Q, MK_FLIP_VOTES, MK_SKIP_VOTES, MK_USE_CALM, MK_QUANTILE, MK_ENTER, MK_EXIT, MK_MIN_HIST, MK_ITERS, MK_HIST_WIN, OBJ_WINDOWS, OBJ_RECENT_WEIGHT, VALIDATION_MODE, VAL_WIN, VAL_GATE, unlist(FIXED_PARAMS), names(FIXED_PARAMS),
                   unlist(CAL), FIXED_T, FIXED_S, MINRES_GRID, DATA_FILE, "ownstart2", OWN_START, OWN_START_DRAWS, OWN_START_TOP, "linroll", LIN_P, LIN_GAIN, "combo", SHRINK, COMBINE_VARS, COMBINE_TRAIN, collapse = "|")
if (!OWN_START) SIGNATURE <- gsub(paste("", "ownstart2", OWN_START, OWN_START_DRAWS, OWN_START_TOP, "linroll "), " linroll ", SIGNATURE, fixed = TRUE)
                                                                     # OWN_START = FALSE -> default start for every stock
if (!is.na(DS)) SIGNATURE <- paste(SIGNATURE, "datastart", format(DS), sep = "|")
LOG_FILE <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "progress.log")
log_line <- function(...) { s <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), "  ", ...); message(s); cat(s, "\n", file = LOG_FILE, append = TRUE) }

VSHIFT <- if (VALIDATION_MODE) VAL_WIN else 0                      # calibration happens VAL_WIN months before the trade month
m_first <- which(vapply(seq_len(D$Tn), function(m) m - VSHIFT >= 1 && windows_of(W0, m - VSHIFT)$train[1] >= 1, TRUE))[1]

# ---- own starting point (OWN_START): this stock's first feasible month, random sets in the table's ranges, best few optimised ----
START_DESC <- "default (Regr 36, Z 30, Train_MO 24, Test_MO 9, n 5, Corr_t 0.7, equal weights)"
START_TAB <- NULL
if (OWN_START) {
  OS_FILE <- file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("own_start_%s.rds", if (QUICK_MODE) "quick" else "full"))
  os <- if (file.exists(OS_FILE)) readRDS(OS_FILE) else NULL
  if (is.null(os) || !identical(os$signature, SIGNATURE)) {
    nm0 <- n_max_of(W0); th_of0 <- function(u, U) to_theta(u, U, nm0)
    hi_int <- function(p) { mx <- PARAM_MAX[[p]]; if (is.finite(mx)) mx else 100 }
    draw_u <- function() {                                             # one random parameter set anywhere in the ranges
      th <- as.list(setNames(SPEC$start, SPEC$name))
      for (i in I_INT) th[[SPEC$name[i]]] <- sample(SPEC$lo[i]:max(SPEC$lo[i], hi_int(SPEC$name[i])), 1)
      if (length(I_N)) th[[SPEC$name[I_N]]] <- sample(N_RANGE[1]:max(N_RANGE[1], min(N_RANGE[2], nm0)), 1)
      if (length(I_LOGIT)) th[[SPEC$name[I_LOGIT]]] <- runif(1, max(CORR_RANGE[1], 0.05), min(CORR_RANGE[2], 0.99))
      if (length(I_W)) { g <- rexp(length(I_W)); th[SPEC$name[I_W]] <- as.list(g / sum(g)) }
      if (length(I_REAL)) for (i in I_REAL) th[[SPEC$name[i]]] <- rnorm(1)
      theta_to_u(th, nm0) }
    set.seed(SEED + 777); pool <- c(list(U_INIT), lapply(seq_len(OWN_START_DRAWS), function(i) draw_u()))
    feas <- function(v) is.finite(v) & v > INFEAS / 2
    m0 <- NA; sc <- NULL
    for (m in seq(m_first, D$Tn)) {                                    # first month where any set gives a working model
      mc <- m - VSHIFT; if (mc < 1) next
      sc <- unlist(parallel::mclapply(pool, function(u) obj_eval(D, th_of0(u, NULL), W0, mc), mc.cores = N_CORES))
      if (any(feas(sc))) { m0 <- m; break }
    }
    if (is.na(m0)) { os <- list(signature = SIGNATURE, u = U_INIT, m0 = NA, obj = NA, obj_default = NA)
    } else {
      mc <- m0 - VSHIFT; f0 <- function(u, U = NULL) obj_eval(D, th_of0(u, U), W0, mc)
      top <- order(ifelse(feas(sc), sc, -Inf), decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(OWN_START_TOP, sum(feas(sc))))]
      CAL0 <- list(starts = 1, iters = max(30, CAL$iters), n_pert = CAL$n_pert)
      res <- parallel::mclapply(top, function(i) { set.seed(SEED + 900 + i); nag(f0, pool[[i]], CAL0, th_of0) },
                                mc.cores = min(N_CORES, length(top)), mc.preschedule = FALSE)
      best <- res[[which.max(vapply(res, `[[`, 0, "f"))]]
      os <- list(signature = SIGNATURE, u = theta_to_u(best$th), th = best$th, m0 = m0, obj = best$f, obj_default = sc[1])
    }
    saveRDS(os, OS_FILE)
  }
  if (!is.na(os$m0)) {
    U_INIT <- os$u; th0 <- to_theta(U_INIT)
    m_first <- max(m_first, os$m0)                                     # no month before the start was found (no lookahead)
    START_DESC <- sprintf("own, found at %s: Regr %d, Z %d, Train_MO %d, Test_MO %d, n %d, Corr_t %.2f, weights %s (OOS R2 %.3f vs default %s)",
      format(D$dates[os$m0], "%Y-%m"), th0$Regr_Win, th0$Z_Win, th0$Train_MO, th0$Test_MO, th0$n, th0$Corr_t,
      paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", WEIGHTS, unlist(th0[WEIGHTS])), collapse = " / "), os$obj,
      if (is.finite(os$obj_default) && os$obj_default > INFEAS / 2) sprintf("%.3f", os$obj_default) else "infeasible")
  } else START_DESC <- "default (no month with a working model found for the own start)"
  log_line(STOCK, " starting point: ", START_DESC)
}
state <- list(m_next = m_first, W = NULL, W_used = NULL, win_hist = NULL, u_raw = NULL, th_raw = NULL, ema_th = NULL, tr_raw = NULL, tr_used = NULL,
              rows = list(), sig = data.frame(k = integer(0), entry = integer(0), dir = numeric(0), resid = numeric(0), sigma = numeric(0)),
              dec = list(), winlog = list(), strat = list(), vallog = list(), mk_hist = NULL, mk_state = 1L,
              mk_r2 = numeric(0), mk_H3 = NULL, mk_m3 = integer(0), mk_He = list())
if (file.exists(CK_FILE)) { ck <- readRDS(CK_FILE); if (identical(ck$signature, SIGNATURE)) { state <- ck$state
  log_line("Resumed at ", format(D$dates[min(state$m_next, D$Tn)], "%Y-%m")) } }

LONG_NAMES <- c("Regr_Win", "Z_Win", "Train_MO", "Test_MO", "n")
same_pair <- function(a, b) a$train == b$train && a$test == b$test
t_start <- Sys.time()
for (m in seq(state$m_next, D$Tn)) {
  if (m > D$Tn) break
  u_warm <- if (WARM_START && !is.null(state$u_raw)) state$u_raw else U_INIT
  cal <- NULL; m_cal <- m - VSHIFT                                     # calibration month (test window ends VAL_WIN months back)
  # (1) window pair (fix 6): screen the grid, fully calibrate the top K + current pair, keep the best calibrated OOS R2
  if (is.null(state$W) || WINDOW_UPDATE == "monthly" || format(D$dates[m], "%m") == "01") {
    th_cur <- if (is.null(state$ema_th)) th0 else state$ema_th
    cands <- choose_windows(D, m_cal, th_cur, WINDOW_TOP_K)
    if (!is.null(state$W) && !any(vapply(cands, same_pair, TRUE, b = state$W)))
      cands <- c(cands, list(list(train = state$W$train, test = state$W$test, score = NA_real_)))
    if (length(cands)) {
      cals <- lapply(cands, function(Wc) calibrate_model(D, m_cal, Wc, u_warm, state$u_raw, SEED + m, state$th_raw))
      ob <- vapply(cals, function(x) if (is.finite(x$objm)) x$objm else -Inf, 0)   # choose the pair on the multi-window objective
      j <- which.max(ob); state$W <- cands[[j]]; cal <- cals[[j]]
      state$winlog[[length(state$winlog) + 1]] <- data.frame(Month = format(D$dates[m], "%Y-%m"),
        Train_Win = state$W$train, Test_Win = state$W$test, Screen_Avg_OOS_R2 = state$W$score,
        Calibrated_OOS_R2 = cal$obj, Calibrated_Objective_Multi = cal$objm, Pairs_Calibrated = length(cands),
        Best_Other_Calibrated = if (length(ob) > 1 && any(is.finite(ob[-j]))) max(ob[-j][is.finite(ob[-j])]) else NA_real_)
    }
  }
  if (is.null(state$W)) { state$m_next <- m + 1; next }
  W <- state$W                                                         # raw (calibrated) window pair
  state$win_hist <- rbind(state$win_hist, c(W$train, W$test))                 # raw window choices up to month m
  vt <- smooth_one("Train_Win", state$sm_prev$Train_Win, state$win_hist[, 1]); state$sm_prev$Train_Win <- vt
  vs <- smooth_one("Test_Win",  state$sm_prev$Test_Win,  state$win_hist[, 2]); state$sm_prev$Test_Win  <- vs
  W_used <- list(train = snap_win(vt, TRAIN_WIN_RANGE, TRAIN_WIN_STEP), test = snap_win(vs, TEST_WIN_RANGE, TEST_WIN_STEP))
  if (windows_of(W_used, m)$train[1] < 1) W_used <- list(train = W$train, test = W$test)   # safety: never use a pair without enough history
  state$W_used <- W_used
  nm <- n_max_of(W)
  # (2) model parameters: SPSA (best-ever) + polish, extra start from last month (fixes 3-5); optional smoothing
  if (is.null(cal)) cal <- calibrate_model(D, m_cal, W, u_warm, state$u_raw, SEED + m, state$th_raw)
  state$u_raw <- cal$u; th_raw <- cal$th; state$th_raw <- th_raw
  for (p in SPEC$name) state$th_hist[[p]] <- c(state$th_hist[[p]], th_raw[[p]])     # raw history (rolling smoothers)
  new_ema <- lapply(SPEC$name, function(p) unname(smooth_one(p, state$ema_th[[p]], state$th_hist[[p]])))
  state$ema_th <- setNames(new_ema, SPEC$name)
  nm_used <- n_max_of(W_used)
  th_used <- round_theta(state$ema_th, nm_used)
  if (!VALIDATION_MODE) {
  ev <- model_eval(D, th_used, W_used, m, detail = TRUE)
  # (3) trade rules: grid on return x Sharpe, then Min_Res smoothed as set in the parameter table
  trc <- calib_trade_rules(D, state$sig, m, W_used, state$tr_raw)
  state$tr_raw <- trc$rules
  state$tr_hist <- rbind(state$tr_hist, trc$rules)
  prev_mr <- if (is.null(state$tr_used)) NULL else state$tr_used[["min_res"]]
  state$tr_used <- trc$rules; state$tr_used[["min_res"]] <- smooth_one("Min_Res", prev_mr, state$tr_hist[, "min_res"])   # TP / SL are fixed
  tr <- state$tr_used
  # (4) signal and trade
  trade <- FALSE
  if (isTRUE(ev$ok) && is.finite(ev$resid)) {
    state$sig <- rbind(state$sig, data.frame(k = m, entry = D$entry_idx[m], dir = -sign(ev$resid), resid = ev$resid, sigma = ev$sigma))
    trade <- abs(ev$resid) > tr[["min_res"]] * ev$sigma && !is.na(D$entry_idx[m])
  }
  state$dec[[length(state$dec) + 1]] <- list(m = m, ev = ev, tr = tr, trade = trade)
  } else {
  # ---- validation stage: the four strategies ----
  W_val  <- list(train = W_used$train, test = VAL_WIN)               # training window ends just before the validation window
  nm_val <- min(N_RANGE[2], PER_VAR_N(W_val$train))
  W_hist <- list(train = W_used$train, test = W$test + VAL_WIN)       # past signals used to calibrate Min_Res
  val_of <- function(th) { e <- model_eval(D, round_theta(th, nm_val), W_val, m); if (isTRUE(e$ok)) e$obj else -Inf }
  vc <- vapply(cal$cands, val_of, 0); ia <- which.max(vc)              # candidate that holds up best on validation
  use_a  <- is.finite(vc[1]) && vc[1] < 0                              # (d): winner failed validation -> use the best validation candidate
  choice <- list(base = cal$th, a = cal$cands[[ia]], b = cal$th, c = cal$cands[[ia]], d = if (use_a) cal$cands[[ia]] else cal$th)
  gated  <- c(base = FALSE, a = FALSE, b = TRUE, c = TRUE, d = FALSE)
  empty_sig <- data.frame(k = integer(0), entry = integer(0), dir = numeric(0), resid = numeric(0), sigma = numeric(0))
  for (sname in names(choice)) {
    S <- state$strat[[sname]]; if (is.null(S)) S <- list(ema = NULL, tr_raw = NULL, tr_used = NULL, sig = empty_sig, dec = list())
    thc <- choice[[sname]]
    for (p in SPEC$name) S$th_hist[[p]] <- c(S$th_hist[[p]], thc[[p]])
    S$ema <- setNames(lapply(SPEC$name, function(p) unname(smooth_one(p, S$ema[[p]], S$th_hist[[p]]))), SPEC$name)
    th_s <- round_theta(S$ema, nm_val)
    ev_s <- model_eval(D, th_s, W_val, m, detail = TRUE)               # validation OOS R2 (ev_s$obj) + trade-month residual
    trc_s <- calib_trade_rules(D, S$sig, m, W_hist, S$tr_raw)
    S$tr_raw <- trc_s$rules
    S$tr_hist <- rbind(S$tr_hist, trc_s$rules)
    prev_mr <- if (is.null(S$tr_used)) NULL else S$tr_used[["min_res"]]
    S$tr_used <- trc_s$rules; S$tr_used[["min_res"]] <- smooth_one("Min_Res", prev_mr, S$tr_hist[, "min_res"])
    pass <- !gated[[sname]] || (isTRUE(ev_s$ok) && ev_s$obj > VAL_GATE)
    trade_s <- FALSE
    if (isTRUE(ev_s$ok) && is.finite(ev_s$resid)) {
      S$sig <- rbind(S$sig, data.frame(k = m, entry = D$entry_idx[m], dir = -sign(ev_s$resid), resid = ev_s$resid, sigma = ev_s$sigma))
      trade_s <- pass && abs(ev_s$resid) > S$tr_used[["min_res"]] * ev_s$sigma && !is.na(D$entry_idx[m])
    }
    S$dec[[length(S$dec) + 1]] <- list(m = m, ev = ev_s, tr = S$tr_used, trade = trade_s, pass = pass, th = th_s, trc = trc_s)
    state$strat[[sname]] <- S
  }
  state$vallog[[length(state$vallog) + 1]] <- data.frame(Month = format(D$dates[m], "%Y-%m"), Candidates = length(vc),
    Val_R2_winner = vc[1], Val_R2_best_candidate = vc[ia], Chosen_is_winner = ia == 1,
    Val_R2_base_used = state$strat$base$dec[[length(state$strat$base$dec)]]$ev$obj,
    Gate_b_pass = state$strat$b$dec[[length(state$strat$b$dec)]]$pass, Gate_c_pass = state$strat$c$dec[[length(state$strat$c$dec)]]$pass,
    Trade_base = state$strat$base$dec[[length(state$strat$base$dec)]]$trade, Trade_a = state$strat$a$dec[[length(state$strat$a$dec)]]$trade,
    Trade_b = state$strat$b$dec[[length(state$strat$b$dec)]]$trade, Trade_c = state$strat$c$dec[[length(state$strat$c$dec)]]$trade,
    Switch_uses = if (use_a) "a (choose)" else "base", Trade_d = state$strat$d$dec[[length(state$strat$d$dec)]]$trade)
  # the baseline strategy drives the standard outputs (Trades, charts, forward check)
  db <- state$strat$base$dec[[length(state$strat$base$dec)]]
  ev <- db$ev; tr <- db$tr; trade <- db$trade; th_used <- db$th; trc <- db$trc; nm_used <- nm_val
  state$dec[[length(state$dec) + 1]] <- list(m = m, ev = ev, tr = tr, trade = trade)
  }
  # (5) Markov state from this month's variance ratio and OOS R2 (history up to month t only)
  mk <- list(p_bad = NA_real_, state = 1L, stay_bad = NA_real_, stay_good = NA_real_, score = NA_real_); mk_x <- c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  mk_x3 <- c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_)
  if (MARKOV_MODE) {
    mk_x <- c(if (isTRUE(ev$ok) && is.finite(ev$var_ratio %||% NA)) max(min(log2(ev$var_ratio), 4), -4) else NA_real_,
              if (isTRUE(ev$ok) && is.finite(ev$obj)) max(min(ev$obj, 1), -1) else NA_real_)
    state$mk_hist <- rbind(state$mk_hist, mk_x)
    if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") {
      sigs_mk <- if (VALIDATION_MODE) state$strat$base$sig else state$sig        # all baseline signals so far (traded or not)
      input1 <- function(w) {
        if (identical(MK_INPUT1, "reversion")) {                                  # reversion efficacy over the last w completed signals
          sg <- sigs_mk[sigs_mk$k <= m - 1 & is.finite(sigs_mk$resid), , drop = FALSE]; sg <- tail(sg, w)
          if (!nrow(sg)) return(NA_real_)
          nx <- D$y[sg$k + 1]; ok <- is.finite(nx)                               # next-month return, known by month m's close
          if (sum(ok) < max(8, ceiling(w / 2)) || sd(sg$resid[ok]) <= 0 || sd(nx[ok]) <= 0) return(NA_real_)
          return(cor(sg$resid[ok], nx[ok]))
        }
        pw <- D$y[max(1, m - w):(m - 1)]; pw <- pw[is.finite(pw)]                 # "retdev": return deviation z-score
        if (length(pw) >= ceiling(0.8 * w) && sd(pw) > 0 && is.finite(D$y[m])) (D$y[m] - mean(pw)) / sd(pw) else NA_real_
      }
      dev <- input1(MK_DEV_MONTHS)
      state$mk_r2 <- c(state$mk_r2, mk_x[2]); r2w <- tail(state$mk_r2, MK_B_SLOPE_MONTHS); okr <- is.finite(r2w)
      slope <- if (sum(okr) >= ceiling(2 * MK_B_SLOPE_MONTHS / 3)) unname(coef(lm(r2w[okr] ~ seq_along(r2w)[okr]))[2]) else NA_real_
      mk_x3 <- c(dev, mk_x[1], slope)                                                # column 2 = variance ratio (names the states)
      state$mk_H3 <- rbind(state$mk_H3, mk_x3); state$mk_m3 <- c(state$mk_m3, m)
      mk <- markov3_state(state$mk_H3, state$mk_m3, state$dec, m)
      # ---- ensemble over input windows + calm-volatility confirmation (history up to month m only) ----
      ens <- vapply(seq_along(MK_ENS_WINDOWS), function(k) {
        w <- MK_ENS_WINDOWS[k]; dv <- input1(w)
        rw <- tail(state$mk_r2, w); ok2 <- is.finite(rw)
        sl <- if (sum(ok2) >= ceiling(2 * w / 3)) unname(coef(lm(rw[ok2] ~ seq_along(rw)[ok2]))[2]) else NA_real_
        prevH <- if (length(state$mk_He) >= k) state$mk_He[[k]] else NULL
        state$mk_He[[k]] <<- rbind(prevH, c(dv, mk_x[1], sl))
        r <- markov3_state(state$mk_He[[k]], state$mk_m3, state$dec, m)$regime; if (is.na(r)) NA_character_ else r }, "")
      vol_of <- function(j) { f1 <- D$first_day[max(1, j - MK_VOL_MONTHS + 1)]; l1 <- D$last_day[j]
        if (is.na(f1) || is.na(l1) || l1 - f1 < 10) NA_real_ else sd(D$r[f1:l1]) * sqrt(252) }
      vhist <- vapply(seq_len(m), vol_of, 0); vt <- vhist[m]
      calm <- is.finite(vt) && sum(is.finite(vhist)) >= 24 && vt <= quantile(vhist, MK_CALM_Q, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_low <- sum(ens == "low", na.rm = TRUE); n_fit <- sum(!is.na(ens))
      flip_ok <- n_fit == length(MK_ENS_WINDOWS) && n_low >= MK_FLIP_VOTES && (!MK_USE_CALM || calm)
      skip_ok <- n_low >= MK_SKIP_VOTES || (MK_USE_CALM && calm)
      mk$action <- if (flip_ok) -1L else if (skip_ok) 0L else 1L
      mk$ens <- paste(ifelse(is.na(ens), "-", ens), collapse = "/"); mk$n_low <- n_low; mk$calm <- calm; mk$vol <- vt
    } else if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3") {
      f1 <- D$first_day[max(1, m - MK_VOL_MONTHS + 1)]; l1 <- D$last_day[m]
      vol <- if (is.na(f1) || is.na(l1) || l1 - f1 < 10) NA_real_ else log(sd(D$r[f1:l1]) * sqrt(252))
      state$mk_r2 <- c(state$mk_r2, mk_x[2]); r2w <- tail(state$mk_r2, MK_SLOPE_MONTHS); okr <- is.finite(r2w)
      slope <- if (sum(okr) >= ceiling(2 * MK_SLOPE_MONTHS / 3)) unname(coef(lm(r2w[okr] ~ seq_along(r2w)[okr]))[2]) else NA_real_
      mk_x3 <- c(mk_x[1], vol, slope)
      state$mk_H3 <- rbind(state$mk_H3, mk_x3); state$mk_m3 <- c(state$mk_m3, m)
      mk <- markov3_state(state$mk_H3, state$mk_m3, state$dec, m)
    } else { mk <- markov_state(state$mk_hist, state$mk_state); state$mk_state <- mk$state }
  }
  state$dec[[length(state$dec)]]$mk <- mk
  state$rows[[length(state$rows) + 1]] <- c(list(Month = format(D$dates[m], "%Y-%m"), Train_Win = W_used$train, Test_Win = W_used$test,
    Train_Win_raw = W$train, Test_Win_raw = W$test, n_max = nm_used),
    setNames(th_raw[SPEC$name], paste0(SPEC$name, "_raw")), th_used[c(SPEC$name, names(FIXED_PARAMS))],
    list(OOS_R2_raw = cal$obj, Objective_Multi_raw = cal$objm, OOS_R2_used = if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$obj else NA,
         t_raw = trc$rules[["t"]], s_raw = trc$rules[["s"]], Min_Res_raw = trc$rules[["min_res"]],
         t = tr[["t"]], s = tr[["s"]], Min_Res = tr[["min_res"]], Trade_Rule_Score = trc$obj, Signals_Used = trc$n,
         Residual = if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$resid else NA, Resid_SD = if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$sigma else NA, Traded = trade,
         BP_Stat = if (is.null(ev$bp_stat)) NA else ev$bp_stat, BP_p = if (is.null(ev$bp_p)) NA else ev$bp_p,
         Var_Ratio = if (is.null(ev$var_ratio)) NA else ev$var_ratio, Max_VIF = if (is.null(ev$vif)) NA else max(ev$vif),
         Lin_RESET_p = if (is.null(ev$lin)) NA_real_ else ev$lin$reset_p,
         Lin_Share_Nonlinear = if (is.null(ev$lin$vars)) NA_real_ else mean(ev$lin$vars$Nonlinear),
         Lin_Nonlinear_Vars = if (is.null(ev$lin$vars)) NA_character_ else paste(ev$lin$vars$Variable[ev$lin$vars$Nonlinear], collapse = "; "),
         Transformed_Vars = if (is.null(ev$forms) || all(ev$forms == "Linear")) "" else
           paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", D$vars[ev$sel][ev$forms != "Linear"], ev$forms[ev$forms != "Linear"]), collapse = "; "),
         MK_Input_log2VR = mk_x[1], MK_Input_OOS_R2 = mk_x[2],
         MK_Input_logVol = if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3") mk_x3[2] else NA_real_, MK_Input_RetDev = if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") mk_x3[1] else NA_real_,
         MK_Input_R2_Slope = mk_x3[3],
         MK_Regime = mk$regime %||% NA_character_, MK_Worst_Regime = mk$worst %||% NA_character_,
         MK_Ensemble = mk$ens %||% NA_character_, MK_Ens_Low_Votes = mk$n_low %||% NA_integer_, MK_Calm = mk$calm %||% NA,
         MK_Vol = mk$vol %||% NA_real_, MK_Action = mk$action %||% NA_integer_,
         MK_Score = mk$score %||% NA_real_, MK_Threshold = mk$thr %||% NA_real_,
         MK_P_bad = mk$p_bad, MK_State = mk$state))
  state$m_next <- m + 1
  el <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "hours"))
  log_line(format(D$dates[m], "%Y-%m"), sprintf(" | win %d/%d (raw %d/%d) | n %d | OOS R2 %.3f | t %.2f s %.2f MinRes %.2f | %s | %.2f h",
           W_used$train, W_used$test, W$train, W$test, th_used$n, if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$obj else NA, tr[["t"]], tr[["s"]], tr[["min_res"]],
           if (trade) ifelse(ev$resid < 0, "BUY", "SELL") else "no trade", el))
  if (m %% CHECKPOINT_EVERY == 0) saveRDS(list(signature = SIGNATURE, state = state), CK_FILE)
}
saveRDS(list(signature = SIGNATURE, state = state), CK_FILE)
```
