## Validation strategies

With `VALIDATION_MODE = TRUE`, four strategies run side by side, all with the same calibration on the 24-month test window that ends `VAL_WIN` months before the trade month:

- **Baseline:** the test-window winner, trading every signal.
- **(a) Choose:** the candidate parameter set that holds up best on the `VAL_WIN`-month validation window.
- **(b) Gate:** the test-window winner, trading only if its validation OOS R² is above `VAL_GATE`.
- **(c) Choose + gate:** the best validation candidate, trading only if its validation OOS R² is above `VAL_GATE`.
- **(d) Switch:** the best validation candidate (as in a) in months when the test-window winner's validation OOS R² is below 0, the test-window winner (as in Baseline) otherwise. The validation window ends at or before the trade month, so this uses no future data.

Each strategy keeps its own signal history, `Min_Res` and smoothing. Portfolios are measured over the same dates.

```{r strategies, eval = isTRUE(get0("VALIDATION_MODE"))}
S_LAB <- c(base = "Baseline", a = "(a) Choose", b = "(b) Gate", c = "(c) Choose + gate", d = "(d) Switch")
strat_trades <- function(decs) {
  dl <- Filter(function(x) x$trade, decs); if (!length(dl)) return(NULL)
  ent <- vapply(dl, function(x) D$entry_idx[x$m], 0); dir <- vapply(dl, function(x) -sign(x$ev$resid), 0)
  TPv <- vapply(dl, function(x) x$tr[["t"]] * abs(x$ev$resid), 0); SLv <- vapply(dl, function(x) x$tr[["s"]] * abs(x$ev$resid), 0)
  st <- sim_trades(D, ent, dir, TPv, SLv, D$n_days)
  data.frame(Decision_Month = vapply(dl, function(x) format(D$dates[x$m], "%Y-%m"), ""), Entry_Day = D$ddates[ent], Exit_Day = D$ddates[st$exit],
             Validation_OOS_R2 = vapply(dl, function(x) x$ev$obj, 0), Variables_Used = vapply(dl, function(x) paste(D$vars[x$ev$sel], collapse = "; "), ""),
             Actual_minus_Fitted = vapply(dl, function(x) x$ev$resid, 0), Signal = ifelse(dir > 0, "BUY", "SELL"), TP = TPv, SL = -SLv,
             Return = st$gross - 2 * COST_PER_SIDE, Exit_Reason = st$reason, Hit = as.integer(st$gross - 2 * COST_PER_SIDE > 0),
             .e = ent, .x = st$exit, .d = dir, check.names = FALSE)
}
ST <- setNames(lapply(names(S_LAB), function(sn) strat_trades(state$strat[[sn]]$dec)), names(S_LAB))
f0 <- min(unlist(lapply(ST, function(x) if (!is.null(x)) min(x$.e))))
s_days <- D$ddates[f0:D$n_days]
SRP <- lapply(ST, function(x) if (is.null(x)) numeric(D$n_days - f0 + 1) else port_returns(D, x$.e, x$.x, x$.d, f0, D$n_days))
vlog <- do.call(rbind, state$vallog)
s_stats <- function(sn) {
  r <- SRP[[sn]]; x <- ST[[sn]]; e <- cumprod(1 + r); yrs <- length(r) / 252; cl <- if (is.null(x)) NULL else x[x$Exit_Reason != "Open", ]
  c(Trades = if (is.null(cl)) 0 else nrow(cl), Hit = if (is.null(cl) || !nrow(cl)) NA else mean(cl$Hit),
    Avg = if (is.null(cl) || !nrow(cl)) NA else mean(cl$Return), Sum = if (is.null(cl)) 0 else sum(cl$Return),
    Total = e[length(e)] - 1, CAGR = e[length(e)]^(1 / yrs) - 1, Sharpe = if (sd(r) > 0) mean(r) / sd(r) * sqrt(252) else NA,
    MaxDD = min(e / cummax(e) - 1))
}
SS <- sapply(names(S_LAB), s_stats)
fmtp <- function(v, d = 2) ifelse(is.na(v), "-", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f%%"), 100 * v))
strat_tab <- data.frame(Metric = c("Trades", "Hit rate", "Avg trade return", "Sum of trade returns", "Portfolio total return",
                                   "CAGR", "Sharpe", "Max drawdown", "Months passing the validation gate"), check.names = FALSE)
for (sn in names(S_LAB)) strat_tab[[S_LAB[[sn]]]] <- c(SS["Trades", sn], fmtp(SS["Hit", sn], 1), fmtp(SS["Avg", sn]), fmtp(SS["Sum", sn], 1),
  fmtp(SS["Total", sn], 1), fmtp(SS["CAGR", sn]), sprintf("%.2f", SS["Sharpe", sn]), fmtp(SS["MaxDD", sn], 1),
  if (sn == "b") fmtp(mean(vlog$Gate_b_pass), 0) else if (sn == "c") fmtp(mean(vlog$Gate_c_pass), 0)
  else if (sn == "d") sprintf("uses (a) in %s", fmtp(mean(vlog$Switch_uses == "a (choose)"), 0)) else "-")
strat_tab
data.frame(Item = c("Months with a validation stage", "Candidates per month (average)", "Best validation candidate = test-window winner",
                    "Median validation OOS R2 of the winner", "Median validation OOS R2 of the best candidate"),
           Value = c(nrow(vlog), sprintf("%.1f", mean(vlog$Candidates)), fmtp(mean(vlog$Chosen_is_winner), 0),
                     sprintf("%.3f", median(vlog$Val_R2_winner[is.finite(vlog$Val_R2_winner)])),
                     sprintf("%.3f", median(vlog$Val_R2_best_candidate[is.finite(vlog$Val_R2_best_candidate)]))))
```


## Markov states

With `MK_METHOD = "hmm3b"` (default): a 3-state Markov model on **VLO's return deviation** this month (z-score against the past `MK_DEV_MONTHS` months), the **variance ratio** and the **slope of the validation OOS R²** over `MK_B_SLOPE_MONTHS` months. The states are named by their variance ratio (low / mid / high), and `MK_BAD_REGIME_B` (default "low") is state 0.

With `MK_METHOD = "hmm3"`: a **3-state Markov model** is fitted every month, on history up to that month, to three inputs: the **variance ratio** (log2), **VLO's realised volatility** over the last `MK_VOL_MONTHS` months (log) and the **slope of the validation OOS R²** over the last `MK_SLOPE_MONTHS` months. The states are named by their volatility (calm / normal / turbulent). By default (`MK_BAD_REGIME = "calm"`) the **calm (low-volatility) regime is state 0**, a choice fixed in advance because it was the weak regime in every earlier run; trade outcomes play no part. With `MK_BAD_REGIME = "learned"`, the trades already **closed** by then are grouped by the state they were made in; the state with the worst average (at least `MK_MIN_TRADES` trades) is state 0 and is skipped or flipped, **but only if that average is below `MK_BAD_BELOW` (default 0, i.e. it lost money)**; when every regime is profitable, everything trades. The direction is therefore learned from past results, not fixed in advance. With `MK_METHOD = "threshold"` or `"hmm"`, the description below applies.

A 2-state Markov model is fitted every month, on the history up to that month, to a combined score of two inputs (each standardised on that history and added): the **variance ratio** (log2 of test / training residual variance, capped at ±4) and the **OOS R²** of the model behind the trade (the validation R² in validation mode; capped at −1…1). The "bad" state is the low-score state, i.e. both inputs low. The state is binary (1 = good, 0 = bad), switching to 0 when the filtered P(bad) exceeds `MK_ENTER` and back to 1 only below `MK_EXIT`. Signals and `Min_Res` do not depend on the state, so the three versions below trade exactly the same signals: **Baseline** trades all of them, **Markov skip** skips them in state 0, **Markov flip** reverses them in state 0.

```{r markov, eval = isTRUE(get0("MARKOV_MODE"))}
mk_trades <- function(decs, rule) {
  act <- function(x) x$mk$action %||% 1L
  dl <- Filter(function(x) x$trade && !(rule == "skip" && identical(x$mk$state, 0L)) && !(rule == "graded" && identical(act(x), 0L)), decs)
  if (!length(dl)) return(NULL)
  flip <- vapply(dl, function(x) (rule == "flip" && identical(x$mk$state, 0L)) || (rule == "graded" && identical(act(x), -1L)), TRUE)
  ent <- vapply(dl, function(x) D$entry_idx[x$m], 0); dir <- vapply(dl, function(x) -sign(x$ev$resid), 0) * ifelse(flip, -1, 1)
  TPo <- vapply(dl, function(x) x$tr[["t"]] * abs(x$ev$resid), 0); SLo <- vapply(dl, function(x) x$tr[["s"]] * abs(x$ev$resid), 0)
  TPv <- ifelse(flip, SLo, TPo); SLv <- ifelse(flip, TPo, SLo)                      # a reversed trade swaps its TP and SL distances
  st <- sim_trades(D, ent, dir, TPv, SLv, D$n_days)
  data.frame(Decision_Month = vapply(dl, function(x) format(D$dates[x$m], "%Y-%m"), ""), Entry_Day = D$ddates[ent], Exit_Day = D$ddates[st$exit],
             State = vapply(dl, function(x) x$mk$state, 0L), P_bad = vapply(dl, function(x) x$mk$p_bad, 0), Flipped = flip,
             Signal = ifelse(dir > 0, "BUY", "SELL"), Return = st$gross - 2 * COST_PER_SIDE, Exit_Reason = st$reason,
             Hit = as.integer(st$gross - 2 * COST_PER_SIDE > 0), .e = ent, .x = st$exit, .d = dir, check.names = FALSE)
}
MK_LAB <- c(base = "Baseline", skip = "Markov skip", flip = "Markov flip")
MKT <- list(base = mk_trades(state$dec, "none"), skip = mk_trades(state$dec, "skip"), flip = mk_trades(state$dec, "flip"))
mf0 <- min(unlist(lapply(MKT, function(x) if (!is.null(x)) min(x$.e)))); mk_days <- D$ddates[mf0:D$n_days]
MKR <- lapply(MKT, function(x) if (is.null(x)) numeric(D$n_days - mf0 + 1) else port_returns(D, x$.e, x$.x, x$.d, mf0, D$n_days))
mk_row <- function(k) { x <- MKT[[k]]; r <- MKR[[k]]; e <- cumprod(1 + r); cl <- if (is.null(x)) x else x[x$Exit_Reason != "Open", ]
  half <- function(a, b) if (is.null(cl)) 0 else sum(cl$Return[substr(cl$Decision_Month, 1, 4) >= a & substr(cl$Decision_Month, 1, 4) <= b])
  c(if (is.null(cl)) 0 else nrow(cl), if (is.null(cl)) NA else mean(cl$Hit), if (is.null(cl)) NA else mean(cl$Return),
    half("0000", "2019"), half("2020", "9999"), e[length(e)] - 1, e[length(e)]^(252 / length(r)) - 1,
    if (sd(r) > 0) mean(r) / sd(r) * sqrt(252) else NA, min(e / cummax(e) - 1)) }
MS <- sapply(names(MK_LAB), mk_row)
mks <- calib[, intersect(c("Month", "Date", "MK_Input_log2VR", "MK_Input_OOS_R2", "MK_Input_logVol", "MK_Input_RetDev", "MK_Input_R2_Slope", "MK_Regime",
                 "MK_Ensemble", "MK_Ens_Low_Votes", "MK_Calm", "MK_Vol", "MK_Action",
                 "MK_Worst_Regime", "MK_Score", "MK_Threshold", "MK_P_bad", "MK_State"), names(calib))]
mk_tab <- data.frame(Metric = c("Trades", "Hit rate", "Avg trade return", "Sum of trade returns, before 2020", "Sum of trade returns, 2020 onwards",
                                "Portfolio total return", "CAGR", "Sharpe", "Max drawdown"), check.names = FALSE)
for (k in names(MK_LAB)) mk_tab[[MK_LAB[[k]]]] <- c(MS[1, k], fmtp(MS[2, k], 1), fmtp(MS[3, k]), fmtp(MS[4, k], 1), fmtp(MS[5, k], 1),
                                                  fmtp(MS[6, k], 1), fmtp(MS[7, k]), sprintf("%.2f", MS[8, k]), fmtp(MS[9, k], 1))
mk_tab
LBL3 <- if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") c("low", "mid", "high") else c("calm", "normal", "turbulent")
if (MK_METHOD %in% c("hmm3", "hmm3b")) {
  rg <- data.frame(Decision_Month = vapply(state$dec, function(x) format(D$dates[x$m], "%Y-%m"), ""),
                   Regime = vapply(state$dec, function(x) x$mk$regime %||% NA_character_, ""))
  bt3 <- merge(MKT$base[MKT$base$Exit_Reason != "Open", ], rg, by = "Decision_Month")
  bt3$Period <- ifelse(substr(bt3$Decision_Month, 1, 4) < "2020", "before 2020", "2020 onwards")

    one <- function(per) { x <- bt3[bt3$Regime %in% r & (per == "all" | bt3$Period == per), ]
      if (!nrow(x)) "-" else sprintf("%d trades, avg %s, hit %s", nrow(x), fmtp(mean(x$Return)), fmtp(mean(x$Hit), 0)) }
    data.frame(Regime = r, `Months in regime` = sum(mks$MK_Regime %in% r), `Before 2020` = one("before 2020"),
               `2020 onwards` = one("2020 onwards"), All = one("all"),
               `Avg variance ratio (log2)` = round(mean(mks$MK_Input_log2VR[mks$MK_Regime %in% r], na.rm = TRUE), 2),
               `Avg volatility` = if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3") fmtp(mean(exp(mks$MK_Input_logVol[mks$MK_Regime %in% r]), na.rm = TRUE), 0) else "-",
               `Avg first input (reversion corr. or return z)` = if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") round(mean(mks$MK_Input_RetDev[mks$MK_Regime %in% r], na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA,
               `Avg R2 slope / month` = round(mean(mks$MK_Input_R2_Slope[mks$MK_Regime %in% r], na.rm = TRUE), 3), check.names = FALSE)
  }))
}
if (exists("reg_tab")) reg_tab
if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b" && "MK_Action" %in% names(calib)) {
  ac <- data.frame(Decision_Month = calib$Month, Action = calib$MK_Action)

      if (!nrow(x)) "-" else sprintf("%d trades, avg %s, hit %s", nrow(x), fmtp(mean(x$Return)), fmtp(mean(x$Hit), 0)) }
    data.frame(`Graded action` = c(`1` = "trade", `0` = "skip", `-1` = "flip")[[as.character(a)]],
               Months = sum(calib$MK_Action %in% a), `Baseline trades before 2020` = one("before 2020"),
               `Baseline trades 2020 onwards` = one("2020 onwards"), All = one("all"), check.names = FALSE) }))

}
if (exists("reg_tab")) data.frame(Item = c("Regime currently treated as bad (state 0)", "Months where a losing regime existed", "Regime switches"),
             Value = c(tail(mks$MK_Worst_Regime, 1) %||% "-", sum(!is.na(mks$MK_Worst_Regime)), sum(head(mks$MK_Regime, -1) != tail(mks$MK_Regime, -1), na.rm = TRUE)))
bt <- MKT$base[MKT$base$Exit_Reason != "Open", ]
data.frame(Item = c("Months in state 0 (bad)", "State switches", "Baseline avg trade in state 1 / state 0",
                    "Baseline hit rate in state 1 / state 0", "Typical length of bad / good state (last fit)"),
           Value = c(sprintf("%d of %d (%.0f%%)", sum(mks$MK_State == 0), nrow(mks), 100 * mean(mks$MK_State == 0)), sum(diff(mks$MK_State) != 0),
                     sprintf("%s (%d trades) / %s (%d trades)", fmtp(mean(bt$Return[bt$State == 1])), sum(bt$State == 1), fmtp(mean(bt$Return[bt$State == 0])), sum(bt$State == 0)),
                     sprintf("%s / %s", fmtp(mean(bt$Hit[bt$State == 1]), 0), fmtp(mean(bt$Hit[bt$State == 0]), 0)),
                     { lr <- state$dec[[length(state$dec)]]$mk; if (MK_METHOD %in% c("hmm3", "hmm3b")) sprintf(paste0("%s months (", paste(LBL3, collapse = " / "), ", last fit)"),
                         paste(round(1 / (1 - (lr$stay %||% rep(NA, 3)))), collapse = " / ")) else if (MK_METHOD == "hmm") sprintf("%.0f / %.0f months", 1 / (1 - lr$stay_bad), 1 / (1 - lr$stay_good))
                       else { rl <- rle(mks$MK_State); sprintf("%.1f / %.1f months (average run, threshold method)", mean(rl$lengths[rl$values == 0]), mean(rl$lengths[rl$values == 1])) } }))
```

## Combined models: validation strategy × Markov rule

Every validation strategy combined with every Markov rule, on the same months. The Markov state of a month is the same for all strategies (it is computed once, from the baseline model's inputs); each strategy keeps its own signals. The **combined model** (`COMBINED_STRATEGY` + `COMBINED_MARKOV`) is shown separately below.

```{r combined, eval = isTRUE(get0("MARKOV_MODE")) && exists("mk_trades")}
SL5 <- c(base = "Baseline", a = "(a) Choose", b = "(b) Gate", c = "(c) Choose + gate", d = "(d) Switch")
mk_by_m <- setNames(lapply(state$dec, function(x) x$mk), vapply(state$dec, function(x) as.character(x$m), ""))
attach_mk <- function(decs) lapply(decs, function(x) { x$mk <- mk_by_m[[as.character(x$m)]] %||% list(state = 1L); x })
SN <- if (isTRUE(VALIDATION_MODE) && length(state$strat)) names(SL5) else "base"
decs_of <- function(sn) if (sn == "base" && !(isTRUE(VALIDATION_MODE) && length(state$strat))) state$dec else attach_mk(state$strat[[sn]]$dec)
RULES <- c(none = "No Markov", skip = "Markov skip", flip = "Markov flip", graded = "Markov graded")
CG <- list(); for (sn in SN) for (ru in names(RULES)) CG[[paste(sn, ru)]] <- mk_trades(decs_of(sn), ru)
cf0 <- min(unlist(lapply(CG, function(x) if (!is.null(x)) min(x$.e)))); c_days <- D$ddates[cf0:D$n_days]
CR <- lapply(CG, function(x) if (is.null(x)) numeric(D$n_days - cf0 + 1) else port_returns(D, x$.e, x$.x, x$.d, cf0, D$n_days))
c_stats <- function(k) { x <- CG[[k]]; r <- CR[[k]]; e <- cumprod(1 + r); cl <- if (is.null(x)) NULL else x[x$Exit_Reason != "Open", ]
  half <- function(a, b) if (is.null(cl)) 0 else sum(cl$Return[substr(cl$Decision_Month, 1, 4) >= a & substr(cl$Decision_Month, 1, 4) <= b])
  data.frame(Trades = if (is.null(cl)) 0 else nrow(cl), `Hit rate` = if (is.null(cl)) "-" else fmtp(mean(cl$Hit), 1),
             `Avg trade` = if (is.null(cl)) "-" else fmtp(mean(cl$Return)), `Sum before 2020` = fmtp(half("0000", "2019"), 1),
             `Sum 2020 onwards` = fmtp(half("2020", "9999"), 1), CAGR = fmtp(e[length(e)]^(252 / length(r)) - 1),
             Sharpe = round(if (sd(r) > 0) mean(r) / sd(r) * sqrt(252) else NA, 2), `Max drawdown` = fmtp(min(e / cummax(e) - 1), 1), check.names = FALSE) }
comb_grid <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(CG), function(k) { p2 <- strsplit(k, " ")[[1]]
  cbind(data.frame(Strategy = SL5[[p2[1]]], Markov = RULES[[p2[2]]], check.names = FALSE), c_stats(k)) }))
comb_grid$Combined <- ifelse(names(CG) == paste(COMBINED_STRATEGY, COMBINED_MARKOV), "<- combined model", "")
comb_grid
ck <- paste(COMBINED_STRATEGY, COMBINED_MARKOV)
if (!ck %in% names(CG)) { cat("Combined model", ck, "not available (check VALIDATION_MODE / MARKOV_MODE); using Baseline + no Markov.\n"); ck <- "base none" }
```

# 10c. Rolling linearity check of the model

Every month the check runs on **the model actually used for that month's signal**: its selected variables, on its own training window (all before the test window, so no lookahead). Three tests:

- **RESET (whole model):** does adding fitted² and fitted³ to the regression improve it (F-test)? A small p-value means the straight-line model is misspecified that month.
- **x² per variable:** does adding the variable's square to the full regression help? Bonferroni within the model: p < `LIN_P` / (number of variables).
- **Transform swap per variable:** the variable is replaced by its signed log or signed square root (scaled by its median |x| in the training window), and the model's adjusted R² is compared. A variable counts as non-linear when the best transform gains ≥ `LIN_GAIN` or the x² test rejects.

With `TRANSFORM_MODE = "report"` this is a report and trades are unchanged. With `"adaptive"` the result is used: each month, a selected variable whose signed log or signed sqrt raises the model's adjusted R² by at least `LIN_GAIN` on the training window enters the model in that form (the forms together must also beat the all-linear model). The decision uses training data only and applies everywhere the model is evaluated: calibration, validation, Markov inputs and trades. The tests below always describe the linear form of the model, so they show why a variable was transformed.

```{r linearity, eval = !identical(get0("TRANSFORM_MODE"), "none")}
r2_of <- function(x, y) { ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); if (sum(ok) < 24 || var(x[ok]) <= 0) return(NA_real_); suppressWarnings(cor(x[ok], y[ok])^2) }
ld <- Filter(function(x) isTRUE(x$ev$ok) && !is.null(x$ev$lin$vars), state$dec)
lin_roll <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ld, function(x) data.frame(Month = format(D$dates[x$m], "%Y-%m"), Model_RESET_p = x$ev$lin$reset_p,
                                                             x$ev$lin$vars, Traded = x$trade, row.names = NULL)))
if (!is.null(lin_roll) && nrow(lin_roll)) {
  lin <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(lin_roll, lin_roll$Variable), function(v) {
    nl <- v[v$Nonlinear, ]; bf <- if (nrow(nl)) names(which.max(table(nl$Best_form))) else "Linear"
    data.frame(Variable = v$Variable[1], Months_selected = nrow(v), Months_nonlinear = nrow(nl), Share_nonlinear = nrow(nl) / nrow(v),
               Most_common_form_when_nonlinear = bf, Median_AdjR2_gain = median(v$AdjR2_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
               Median_P_x2 = median(v$P_x2, na.rm = TRUE), First_month = min(v$Month), Last_month = max(v$Month)) }))
  lin <- lin[order(-lin$Months_nonlinear, -lin$Share_nonlinear), ]; rownames(lin) <- NULL
  mon_lin <- unique(lin_roll[, c("Month", "Model_RESET_p")])
  mon_lin$Share <- tapply(lin_roll$Nonlinear, lin_roll$Month, mean)[mon_lin$Month]
  data.frame(Item = c("Months checked", "Months where the model fails RESET (p < LIN_P)", "Selected variables flagged non-linear (share of variable-months)",
                      "Variables ever selected / ever flagged", "Most common better form (flagged cases): signed log / signed sqrt / x^2 only"),
             Value = c(nrow(mon_lin), sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", sum(mon_lin$Model_RESET_p < LIN_P, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(mon_lin$Model_RESET_p < LIN_P, na.rm = TRUE)),
                       sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(lin_roll$Nonlinear)), sprintf("%d / %d", nrow(lin), sum(lin$Months_nonlinear > 0)),
                       paste(sum(lin_roll$Nonlinear & lin_roll$Best_form == "Signed log"), sum(lin_roll$Nonlinear & lin_roll$Best_form == "Signed sqrt"),
                             sum(lin_roll$Nonlinear & lin_roll$Best_form == "Linear"), sep = " / ")))
  if (TRANSFORM_MODE == "adaptive" && "Transformed_Vars" %in% names(calib))
    print(data.frame(Item = c("Months with at least one transformed variable", "Of which traded"),
                     Value = c(sprintf("%d of %d", sum(calib$Transformed_Vars != ""), nrow(calib)), sum(calib$Transformed_Vars != "" & calib$Traded))))
  head(transform(lin[lin$Months_nonlinear > 0, c("Variable", "Months_selected", "Months_nonlinear", "Most_common_form_when_nonlinear", "Median_AdjR2_gain")],
                 Median_AdjR2_gain = round(Median_AdjR2_gain, 3)), 15)
}
```

# 10b. Forward check: raw vs smoothed parameters

**This section uses future data for evaluation only.** It never feeds back into any decision, parameter or trade above.

The OOS R² in the calibration table is measured on the same test window the raw parameters were optimised on, so it always favours them. This check is fair to both. The parameters chosen at month *t* (raw and smoothed) are applied `Test_Win` months later, so their test window covers the months **from *t* onward**: months that neither set was tuned on. Everything else stays as the model does it: selection at the end of the training window, fit on the training window, OOS R² against the training mean.

```{r forward-check}
if (SMOOTHING == "none") {
  cat("Not applicable: SMOOTHING = \"none\", so the parameters used are the raw calibration (nothing to compare).")
  unlink(file.path(OUT_DIR, "08_forward_oos_r2.png"))   # remove a chart left over from an earlier smoothed run
} else {
nw_t <- function(x, L) {                       # t-stat of a mean with Newey-West errors (overlapping windows)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]; n <- length(x); if (n < 10) return(NA_real_)
  u <- x - mean(x); v <- sum(u^2) / n
  for (l in seq_len(min(L, n - 1))) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (L + 1)) * sum(u[(l + 1):n] * u[1:(n - l)]) / n
  mean(x) / sqrt(v / n)
}
fwd <- do.call(rbind, lapply(state$rows, function(x) {
  m <- match(x$Month, format(D$dates, "%Y-%m"))
  Wr <- list(train = x$Train_Win_raw, test = x$Test_Win_raw); Wu <- list(train = x$Train_Win, test = x$Test_Win)
  th_raw <- add_fixed(setNames(lapply(SPEC$name, function(p) x[[paste0(p, "_raw")]]), SPEC$name)); th_used <- add_fixed(x[SPEC$name])
  f <- function(th, W) { m2 <- m + W$test; if (m2 > D$Tn) NA_real_ else { ev <- model_eval(D, th, W, m2); if (isTRUE(ev$ok)) ev$obj else NA_real_ } }
  data.frame(Month = x$Month, Test_Win = Wu$test, Calib_Window_R2_raw = x$OOS_R2_raw, Calib_Window_R2_used = x$OOS_R2_used,
             Forward_R2_raw = f(th_raw, Wr), Forward_R2_used = f(th_used, Wu))
}))
fwd$Forward_Diff_used_minus_raw <- fwd$Forward_R2_used - fwd$Forward_R2_raw
ok <- is.finite(fwd$Forward_R2_raw) & is.finite(fwd$Forward_R2_used); L <- round(median(fwd$Test_Win))
fwd_summary <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("Months compared", "Calibration window: mean OOS R2 (raw / smoothed)", "FORWARD: mean OOS R2 (raw / smoothed)",
              "FORWARD: median OOS R2 (raw / smoothed)", "FORWARD: months where smoothed beats raw",
              "FORWARD: mean difference (smoothed - raw)", "FORWARD: t-stat of the difference (Newey-West)"),
  Value = c(sum(ok),
            sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", mean(fwd$Calib_Window_R2_raw[ok], na.rm = TRUE), mean(fwd$Calib_Window_R2_used[ok], na.rm = TRUE)),
            sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", mean(fwd$Forward_R2_raw[ok]), mean(fwd$Forward_R2_used[ok])),
            sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", median(fwd$Forward_R2_raw[ok]), median(fwd$Forward_R2_used[ok])),
            sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(fwd$Forward_Diff_used_minus_raw[ok] > 0)),
            sprintf("%+.4f", mean(fwd$Forward_Diff_used_minus_raw[ok])),
            sprintf("%.2f", nw_t(fwd$Forward_Diff_used_minus_raw[ok], L))))
fwd_summary
}
```

A t-stat above +2 means the smoothed parameters generalise better; below −2, the raw ones do. In between, the difference isn't reliable. Consecutive months share most of their forward window, so the t-stat uses Newey-West errors.

# 12. Visuals

```{r viz-setup}
NAVY <- "#1F3A5F"; ORANGE <- "#E07A2E"; GREY <- "#8A94A6"; LIGHT <- "#C9CED8"
thp <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, colour = NAVY),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = GREY), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = NAVY), legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())
save_plot <- function(p, name, w = 10, h = 5.5) { ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, name), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 200, bg = "white",
  device = if (HAS_RAGG) ragg::agg_png else "png"); p }
yr <- format(days, "%Y"); calib$Date <- as.Date(paste0(calib$Month, "-01"))
TWO_SERIES <- SMOOTHING != "none"                       # raw and used differ only when smoothing is on
USED_LABEL <- if (TWO_SERIES) "Used" else "Calibrated"
full_year <- names(which(table(yr) >= 200))             # calendar years with >= 200 trading days
```

```{r viz-usage, fig.height=7}
top <- head(usage, 30)
save_plot(ggplot(top, aes(reorder(Variable, Months_Selected), Months_Selected)) + geom_col(fill = NAVY, width = 0.7) + coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Months_Selected), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.3, colour = GREY) +
  labs(title = "Most used variables", subtitle = "Months each variable was in the model (top 30)", x = NULL, y = "Months") + thp,
  "01_variable_usage.png", h = 7)
```

```{r viz-returns}
ann <- data.frame(Year = full_year, Strategy = as.numeric(tapply(1 + rp, yr, prod)[full_year] - 1),
                  BuyHold = as.numeric(tapply(1 + bh, yr, prod)[full_year] - 1))
al <- rbind(data.frame(Series = "Strategy", Return = ann$Strategy), data.frame(Series = "Buy & hold", Return = ann$BuyHold))
brks <- seq(floor(min(al$Return) * 10) / 10, ceiling(max(al$Return) * 10) / 10 + 0.1, by = 0.1)
save_plot(ggplot(al, aes(Return, fill = Series)) + geom_histogram(breaks = brks, position = "dodge", colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Strategy = NAVY, `Buy & hold` = ORANGE)) + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of annual returns", subtitle = "Full calendar years only; bins of 10 percentage points", x = "Annual return", y = "Years") + thp,
  "02_annual_returns_hist.png")
```

```{r viz-sharpe}
ann_sh <- tapply(rp, yr, function(r) if (isTRUE(sd(r) > 0)) mean(r) / sd(r) * sqrt(252) else NA)[full_year]   # full calendar years only
save_plot(ggplot(data.frame(Sharpe = as.numeric(ann_sh[is.finite(ann_sh)])), aes(Sharpe)) + geom_histogram(bins = 12, fill = NAVY, colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = GREY) + labs(title = "Annual Sharpe ratio", subtitle = "Full calendar years only", x = "Sharpe", y = "Years") + thp,
  "03a_annual_sharpe_hist.png")
if (length(rp) > 252) {
  cr <- cumsum(c(0, rp)); cr2 <- cumsum(c(0, rp^2)); s1 <- diff(cr, lag = 252); s2 <- diff(cr2, lag = 252)
  sdv <- sqrt(pmax((s2 - s1^2 / 252) / 251, 0)); roll <- ifelse(sdv > 1e-12, (s1 / 252) / sdv * sqrt(252), NA)
  save_plot(ggplot(data.frame(Sharpe = roll[is.finite(roll)]), aes(Sharpe)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = ORANGE, colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = GREY) + labs(title = "Rolling 12-month Sharpe ratio", x = "Sharpe", y = "Days") + thp,
    "03b_rolling_sharpe_hist.png")
}
```

```{r viz-hit-rate}
if (ntr) {
  tc <- trades[trades$Exit_Reason != "Open", ]
  roll20 <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(tc)), function(i) if (i < 20) NA_real_ else mean(tc$Hit[(i - 19):i]), 0)
  hl <- rbind(data.frame(Date = tc$Entry_Day, Rate = tc$Cum_Hit_Rate, Series = "Cumulative hit rate"),
              data.frame(Date = tc$Entry_Day, Rate = roll20, Series = "Rolling 20-trade hit rate"))
  save_plot(ggplot(hl, aes(Date, Rate, colour = Series)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, colour = GREY, linetype = 2) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Cumulative hit rate" = NAVY, "Rolling 20-trade hit rate" = ORANGE)) +
    labs(title = "Hit rate over time", subtitle = sprintf("Closed trades by entry date; final hit rate %.1f%% (dashed line = 50%%)",
         100 * mean(tc$Hit)), x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp, "10_hit_rate_curve.png")
}
```

```{r viz-params, fig.height=8}
pn <- c("Train_Win", "Test_Win", "Regr_Win", "Z_Win", "Train_MO", "Test_MO", "n", "Corr_t")
pl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pn, function(p) rbind(
  data.frame(Date = calib$Date, Value = calib[[p]], Series = USED_LABEL, Parameter = p),
  if (TWO_SERIES && paste0(p, "_raw") %in% names(calib)) data.frame(Date = calib$Date, Value = calib[[paste0(p, "_raw")]], Series = "Calibrated (raw)", Parameter = p))))
pl$Parameter <- factor(pl$Parameter, pn)
win_sub <- if (WINDOW_UPDATE == "monthly") paste0("Train_Win / Test_Win re-chosen every month (screen + joint calibration)",
                                                    if (TWO_SERIES) "; smoothed pair used" else "") else
  "Train_Win / Test_Win change only in January (annual recalibration)"
save_plot(ggplot(pl, aes(Date, Value, colour = Series)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c(NAVY, LIGHT), c(USED_LABEL, "Calibrated (raw)"))) +
  labs(title = "Parameters by month", subtitle = win_sub, x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp +
  (if (!TWO_SERIES) theme(legend.position = "none")),
  "06_parameters.png", h = 8)
```

```{r viz-forward, eval = exists("fwd") && !identical(get0("SMOOTHING"), "none")}
fwd$Date <- as.Date(paste0(fwd$Month, "-01"))
roll12 <- function(x) vapply(seq_along(x), function(i) { v <- x[max(1, i - 11):i]; if (sum(is.finite(v)) < 6) NA else mean(v, na.rm = TRUE) }, 0)
fl <- rbind(data.frame(Date = fwd$Date, R2 = roll12(fwd$Forward_R2_raw), Series = "Raw calibration"),
            data.frame(Date = fwd$Date, R2 = roll12(fwd$Forward_R2_used), Series = "Smoothed (used)"))
save_plot(ggplot(fl, aes(Date, R2, colour = Series)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GREY) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Raw calibration" = GREY, "Smoothed (used)" = NAVY)) +
  labs(title = "Forward out-of-sample R²: raw vs smoothed parameters",
       subtitle = "Parameters chosen at each month, tested on the following months (12-month average). Evaluation only.", x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp,
  "08_forward_oos_r2.png")
```

```{r viz-hetero, fig.height=7, eval = isTRUE(get0("HETERO_DIAG"))}
hd <- calib[is.finite(calib$BP_p), ]
if (nrow(hd)) {
  hl <- rbind(data.frame(Date = hd$Date, Value = -log10(pmax(hd$BP_p, 1e-12)), Panel = "Breusch-Pagan: -log10(p)  (above dashed line = heteroskedastic at 5%)"),
              data.frame(Date = hd$Date, Value = log2(hd$Var_Ratio), Panel = "Variance ratio, log2 scale: 0 = unchanged, +1 = test errors doubled, -1 = halved"))
  refs <- data.frame(Panel = unique(hl$Panel), y = c(-log10(0.05), 0))
  save_plot(ggplot(hl, aes(Date, Value)) + geom_hline(data = refs, aes(yintercept = y), linetype = 2, colour = GREY) +
    geom_line(colour = NAVY, linewidth = 0.6) + facet_wrap(~Panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = "Heteroskedasticity of the nowcast regression", subtitle = sprintf("%.0f%% of months heteroskedastic at 5%%; median variance ratio %.2f",
         100 * mean(hd$BP_p < 0.05), median(hd$Var_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE)), x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp, "13_heteroskedasticity.png", h = 7)
}
```

```{r viz-hetero-trades, eval = isTRUE(get0("HETERO_DIAG")) && exists("trades") && "Var_Ratio" %in% names(trades)}
tv <- trades[trades$Exit_Reason != "Open" & is.finite(trades$Var_Ratio), ]
if (nrow(tv) >= 9) {
  tv$Bucket <- cut(tv$Var_Ratio, unique(quantile(tv$Var_Ratio, c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1))), include.lowest = TRUE,
                   labels = c("Low ratio", "Middle", "High ratio")[seq_len(length(unique(quantile(tv$Var_Ratio, c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1)))) - 1)])
  sm <- aggregate(Return ~ Bucket, tv, function(r) c(mean = mean(r), n = length(r), hit = mean(r > 0)))
  sm <- data.frame(Bucket = sm$Bucket, Avg = sm$Return[, "mean"], N = sm$Return[, "n"], Hit = sm$Return[, "hit"])
  save_plot(ggplot(sm, aes(Bucket, Avg, fill = Avg > 0)) + geom_col(width = 0.6) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GREY) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f%%\n%d trades, hit %.0f%%", 100 * Avg, N, 100 * Hit), vjust = ifelse(Avg > 0, -0.3, 1.2)), size = 3.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2E7D32", `FALSE` = "#C62828"), guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = 0.25)) +
    labs(title = "Trade results by variance ratio at decision", subtitle = "Terciles of test / training residual variance: a candidate input for the Markov states",
         x = NULL, y = "Average trade return") + thp, "14_trades_by_variance_ratio.png")
}
```

```{r viz-linearity-time, fig.height=7, eval = exists("mon_lin")}
ml <- mon_lin; ml$Date <- as.Date(paste0(ml$Month, "-01"))
roll12 <- function(x) vapply(seq_along(x), function(i) { v <- x[max(1, i - 11):i]; if (sum(is.finite(v)) < 6) NA else mean(v, na.rm = TRUE) }, 0)
lt <- rbind(data.frame(Date = ml$Date, Value = pmax(-log10(ml$Model_RESET_p), 0), Panel = "1. Whole-model RESET test: -log10(p)  (above the line = misspecified)"),
            data.frame(Date = ml$Date, Value = ml$Share, Panel = "2. Share of the selected variables flagged non-linear"))
lt$Smooth <- ave(lt$Value, lt$Panel, FUN = roll12)
save_plot(ggplot(lt, aes(Date, Value)) + geom_col(fill = GREY, alpha = 0.6, width = 25) + geom_line(aes(y = Smooth), colour = NAVY, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(data = data.frame(Panel = unique(lt$Panel)[1], y = -log10(LIN_P)), aes(yintercept = y), colour = ORANGE, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~Panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Linearity of the model over time", subtitle = sprintf("Model used each month, on its own training window; line = 12-month average. RESET fails in %.0f%% of months",
       100 * mean(ml$Model_RESET_p < LIN_P, na.rm = TRUE)), x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp, "16_linearity_over_time.png", h = 7)
```

```{r viz-linearity-trades, eval = exists("trades") && "Lin_RESET_p" %in% names(trades)}
tl <- trades[trades$Exit_Reason != "Open" & is.finite(trades$Lin_RESET_p), ]
if (nrow(tl) >= 10) {
  tl$Bucket <- factor(ifelse(tl$Lin_RESET_p < LIN_P, "Model misspecified (RESET p < LIN_P)", "Model passes RESET"),
                      levels = c("Model passes RESET", "Model misspecified (RESET p < LIN_P)"))
  sl <- aggregate(Return ~ Bucket, tl, function(r) c(mean = mean(r), n = length(r), hit = mean(r > 0)))
  sl <- data.frame(Bucket = sl$Bucket, Avg = sl$Return[, "mean"], N = sl$Return[, "n"], Hit = sl$Return[, "hit"])
  save_plot(ggplot(sl, aes(Bucket, Avg, fill = Avg > 0)) + geom_col(width = 0.5) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GREY) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f%%\n%d trades, hit %.0f%%", 100 * Avg, N, 100 * Hit), vjust = ifelse(Avg > 0, -0.3, 1.2)), size = 3.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2E7D32", `FALSE` = "#C62828"), guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = 0.25)) +
    labs(title = "Trade results by linearity of the model at decision", subtitle = "A candidate input for the Markov states / break classification",
         x = NULL, y = "Average trade return") + thp, "21_trades_by_linearity.png")
}
```

```{r viz-markov3, fig.height=9, eval = exists("mks") && isTRUE(get0("MK_METHOD") %in% c("hmm3", "hmm3b"))}
LO <- LBL3[1]; HI <- LBL3[3]
rr <- with(rle(ifelse(is.na(mks$MK_Regime), "none", mks$MK_Regime)), { e <- cumsum(lengths); data.frame(r = values, s = e - lengths + 1, e = e) })
rr <- rr[rr$r %in% c(LO, HI), ]
bands <- if (nrow(rr)) data.frame(xmin = mks$Date[rr$s], xmax = mks$Date[rr$e] + 31, Regime = rr$r) else data.frame(xmin = as.Date(character()), xmax = as.Date(character()), Regime = character())
m3 <- rbind(data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Input_log2VR, Panel = "1. Variance ratio (log2)"),
            if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3") data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = exp(mks$MK_Input_logVol), Panel = "2. VLO realised volatility (annualised)")
            else data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Input_RetDev, Panel = if (identical(MK_INPUT1, "reversion"))
              sprintf("2. Reversion efficacy: corr(residual, next-month return), last %d signals (negative = reverting)", MK_DEV_MONTHS)
              else sprintf("2. VLO return deviation vs past %d months (z)", MK_DEV_MONTHS)),
            data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Input_R2_Slope, Panel = sprintf("3. Slope of validation OOS R2 over %d months (per month)",
                       if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") MK_B_SLOPE_MONTHS else MK_SLOPE_MONTHS)),
            if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b" && "MK_Action" %in% names(mks))
              data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Action, Panel = sprintf("4. Graded action: 1 = trade, 0 = skip, -1 = flip (>= %s of %d fits low%s)",
                         MK_FLIP_VOTES, length(MK_ENS_WINDOWS), if (MK_USE_CALM) " + calm" else ""))
            else data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_State, Panel = "4. State used: 1 = trade, 0 = worst regime (skip / flip)"))
m3$Panel <- factor(m3$Panel, unique(m3$Panel))
save_plot(ggplot(m3, aes(Date, Value)) +
  geom_rect(data = bands, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Regime), inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#4A90C2", "#E07A2E"), c(LO, HI)), name = NULL) +
  geom_line(colour = NAVY, linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) + facet_wrap(~Panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Markov regimes (3 states)", subtitle = sprintf("Blue = %s, orange = %s, unshaded = %s%s; state 0 (%s) in %d months",
       LBL3[1], LBL3[3], LBL3[2], if (MK_METHOD == "hmm3b") " variance ratio" else "", tail(mks$MK_Worst_Regime, 1) %||% "-",
       sum(mks$MK_State == 0)), x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp, "17_markov_states.png", h = 9)
```

```{r viz-markov, fig.height=8, eval = exists("mks") && !isTRUE(get0("MK_METHOD") %in% c("hmm3", "hmm3b"))}
mk_runs <- with(rle(mks$MK_State == 0), { end <- cumsum(lengths); start <- end - lengths + 1; data.frame(s = start[values], e = end[values]) })
shade <- if (nrow(mk_runs)) data.frame(xmin = mks$Date[mk_runs$s], xmax = mks$Date[mk_runs$e] + 31) else data.frame(xmin = as.Date(NA), xmax = as.Date(NA))[0, ]
ml <- rbind(data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Input_log2VR, Panel = "1. Variance ratio (log2; 0 = unchanged)"),
            data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Input_OOS_R2, Panel = "2. OOS R2 of the model behind the trade (capped at -1)"),
            data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Score, Panel = "3. Combined score: z(variance ratio) + z(OOS R2)"),
            if (MK_METHOD == "hmm") data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_P_bad, Panel = "4. Filtered P(bad state)  (dashed: enter 0 / leave 0)"))
mref <- if (MK_METHOD == "hmm") data.frame(Panel = rep(unique(ml$Panel), c(1, 1, 1, 2)), y = c(0, 0, 0, MK_ENTER, MK_EXIT)) else
  rbind(data.frame(Panel = unique(ml$Panel)[1:2], y = 0), data.frame(Panel = unique(ml$Panel)[3], y = NA_real_))
ml$Panel <- factor(ml$Panel, unique(ml$Panel))
save_plot(ggplot(ml, aes(Date, Value)) +
  geom_rect(data = shade, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#C62828", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_hline(data = mref[is.finite(mref$y), ], aes(yintercept = y), linetype = 2, colour = GREY) + geom_line(colour = NAVY, linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  (if (MK_METHOD == "threshold") geom_line(data = data.frame(Date = mks$Date, Value = mks$MK_Threshold,
     Panel = factor("3. Combined score: z(variance ratio) + z(OOS R2)", levels(ml$Panel))), colour = ORANGE, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE)) +
  facet_wrap(~Panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Markov states", subtitle = sprintf("Red bands = state 0 (bad): %.0f%% of months, %d switches%s", 100 * mean(mks$MK_State == 0), sum(diff(mks$MK_State) != 0),
       if (MK_METHOD == "threshold") sprintf("; orange dashed = threshold (%.2f quantile of the score so far)", MK_QUANTILE) else ""),
       x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp, "17_markov_states.png", h = 9)
```

# 13. All stocks

With `RUN_ALL = TRUE` every stock in `RUN_ALL_STOCKS` is run with exactly the settings above (nothing re-tuned per stock), each in its own R session and output folder (`MeanReversion_Results_v3_<STOCK>_<RUN_TAG>`, with its own report and Excel file). This section then compares them. Each stock trades only after its own warm-up, so the stocks listed later have shorter trading periods: compare Sharpe ratios together with the trading period and the number of trades, and use the common-period columns for a like-for-like comparison.

```{r all-run, eval = isTRUE(RUN_ALL)}
t_all <- Sys.time()
rmd_in <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
if (is.null(rmd_in) && requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE)) rmd_in <- tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path, error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(rmd_in) || !file.exists(rmd_in)) stop("RUN_ALL needs the file to be knitted (Knit button or rmarkdown::render), not run chunk by chunk.")
bad <- setdiff(RUN_ALL_STOCKS, names(PEER_COLS)); if (length(bad)) stop("Not in PEER_COLS: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
peers <- setdiff(RUN_ALL_STOCKS, STOCK)
rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript")
run_peer <- function(tk) {
  od <- out_dir_for(tk); dir.create(od, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  tmp <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("mr_", tk)); unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
  runner <- file.path(tmp, "run.R")
  writeLines(c(sprintf("Sys.setenv(MR_CHILD_STOCK = %s)", deparse(tk)),
               sprintf("rmarkdown::render(%s, output_file = %s, output_dir = %s, intermediates_dir = %s, knit_root_dir = %s, envir = new.env(), quiet = TRUE)",
                       deparse(rmd_in), deparse(paste0("Mean_Reversion_", tk, ".html")), deparse(od), deparse(tmp), deparse(tmp))), runner)
  log_file <- file.path(od, "render_log.txt"); t0 <- Sys.time()
  cat(format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), " ", tk, " started\n", file = LOG_FILE, append = TRUE, sep = "")
  st <- system2(rscript, shQuote(runner), stdout = log_file, stderr = log_file)
  mins <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))
  cat(format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), " ", tk, if (identical(st, 0L)) " finished" else " FAILED (see render_log.txt)",
      sprintf(" after %.0f min\n", mins), file = LOG_FILE, append = TRUE, sep = "")
  why <- if (identical(st, 0L)) "" else { lg <- tryCatch(readLines(log_file, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) "render_log.txt not readable")
    lg <- trimws(lg[nzchar(trimws(lg)) & !grepl("^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}", lg)])               # drop progress lines
    i <- grep("error|Error|Quitting|not found|cannot|halted", lg); paste(tail(lg[sort(unique(c(i, i + 1)))[sort(unique(c(i, i + 1))) <= length(lg)]], 4), collapse = " | ") }
  data.frame(Stock = tk, Status = if (identical(st, 0L)) "finished" else paste("FAILED:", why),
             Minutes = round(mins), Folder = file.path("results", basename(od)))
}
run_status <- do.call(rbind, parallel::mclapply(peers, run_peer, mc.cores = max(1L, as.integer(RUN_ALL_PARALLEL)), mc.preschedule = FALSE))
run_status
```

```{r all-collect, eval = isTRUE(RUN_ALL)}
ALL <- c(STOCK, peers)
CMP <- list()
for (tk in ALL) {
  f <- file.path(out_dir_for(tk), "compare.rds")
  if (file.exists(f) && (tk == STOCK || file.mtime(f) >= t_all)) CMP[[tk]] <- readRDS(f)   # peers: only results written by this render
}
missing_tk <- setdiff(ALL, names(CMP))
if (length(missing_tk)) cat("No results for:", paste(missing_tk, collapse = ", "), "- they are left out of the comparison.\n")
pst <- function(r) { r <- r[is.finite(r)]; if (length(r) < 2) return(c(CAGR = NA, Sharpe = NA, MaxDD = NA)); e <- cumprod(1 + r)
  c(CAGR = e[length(e)]^(252 / length(r)) - 1, Sharpe = if (sd(r) > 0) mean(r) / sd(r) * sqrt(252) else NA, MaxDD = min(e / cummax(e) - 1)) }
closed <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || !nrow(x)) NULL else x[x$Exit_Reason != "Open", ]
first_trade <- function(x) { cl <- closed(x); if (is.null(cl)) NA else as.Date(min(cl$Entry_Day)) }
# common period: from the latest first trade among the stocks to the common last day
starts <- as.Date(vapply(CMP, function(x) as.numeric(first_trade(x$trades) %||% x$days[1]), 0), origin = "1970-01-01")
starts[is.na(starts)] <- as.Date(vapply(CMP[is.na(starts)], function(x) as.numeric(x$days[1]), 0), origin = "1970-01-01")
names(starts) <- names(CMP)
yrs_trading <- vapply(names(CMP), function(tk) sum(CMP[[tk]]$days >= starts[[tk]]) / 252, 0)
COMMON_MIN_YEARS <- 3                                          # stocks trading for less than this do not set the common start
COMMON_FROM <- max(starts[yrs_trading >= COMMON_MIN_YEARS | names(CMP) == STOCK]); COMMON_TO <- min(as.Date(vapply(CMP, function(x) as.numeric(max(x$days)), 0), origin = "1970-01-01"))
in_common <- function(x, r) if (x$stock %in% names(CMP)[yrs_trading < COMMON_MIN_YEARS & names(CMP) != STOCK]) NA_real_ else
  r[x$days >= COMMON_FROM & x$days <= COMMON_TO]
fp <- function(v, d = 1) ifelse(is.finite(v), sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f%%"), 100 * v), "-")
ALL_SUM <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(CMP), function(tk) { x <- CMP[[tk]]; cl <- closed(x$trades)
  ft <- first_trade(x$trades); keep <- if (is.na(ft)) rep(TRUE, length(x$days)) else x$days >= ft
  sc <- pst(x$comb[keep]); sb <- pst(x$base[keep]); sh <- pst(x$bh[keep])
  cc <- pst(in_common(x, x$comb)); ch <- pst(in_common(x, x$bh))
  data.frame(Stock = tk, `Data from` = format(x$data_from, "%Y-%m"), `Trading from` = if (is.na(ft)) "-" else format(ft, "%Y-%m"),
             Years = round(sum(keep) / 252, 1), Trades = if (is.null(cl)) 0 else nrow(cl),
             `Hit rate` = if (is.null(cl)) "-" else fp(mean(cl$Hit), 0),
             `Sharpe baseline` = round(sb[["Sharpe"]], 2), `Sharpe combined` = round(sc[["Sharpe"]], 2),
             `CAGR combined` = fp(sc[["CAGR"]], 2), `Max DD combined` = fp(sc[["MaxDD"]]),
             `Sharpe buy & hold` = round(sh[["Sharpe"]], 2), `Max DD buy & hold` = fp(sh[["MaxDD"]]),
             `Sharpe combined (common)` = round(cc[["Sharpe"]], 2), `Sharpe buy & hold (common)` = round(ch[["Sharpe"]], 2),
             check.names = FALSE) }))
cat(sprintf("Combined model = %s. Common period: %s to %s (stocks trading under %d years are left out of it). Sharpe, CAGR and drawdowns from each stock's first trade (net of costs).\n",
            CMP[[1]]$comb_label, format(COMMON_FROM, "%Y-%m"), format(COMMON_TO, "%Y-%m"), COMMON_MIN_YEARS))
ALL_SUM
```

```{r all-viz, fig.height=6, eval = isTRUE(RUN_ALL) && length(CMP) > 1}
PAL <- c(NAVY, ORANGE, "#4A90C2", "#2E7D32", "#8E44AD", "#B03A2E", "#C9A227", GREY)
SCOL <- setNames(PAL[seq_along(CMP)], names(CMP))
if ("SUN" %in% names(SCOL)) SCOL[["SUN"]] <- GREY                               # the non-refiner control in grey
ord <- names(CMP)
# (a) Sharpe by stock: baseline, combined, buy & hold (from each stock's first trade)
sh <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ALL_SUM)), function(i) data.frame(Stock = ALL_SUM$Stock[i],
  Series = c("Baseline", "Combined model", "Buy & hold"),
  Sharpe = c(ALL_SUM$`Sharpe baseline`[i], ALL_SUM$`Sharpe combined`[i], ALL_SUM$`Sharpe buy & hold`[i]))))
sh$Stock <- factor(sh$Stock, ord); sh$Series <- factor(sh$Series, c("Baseline", "Combined model", "Buy & hold"))
save_plot(ggplot(sh, aes(Stock, Sharpe, fill = Series)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GREY, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Sharpe), vjust = ifelse(Sharpe >= 0, -0.4, 1.3)), position = position_dodge(0.8), size = 3.2, colour = NAVY) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Baseline = LIGHT, `Combined model` = NAVY, `Buy & hold` = ORANGE)) +
  labs(title = "Sharpe ratio by stock", subtitle = sprintf("Same settings for every stock; combined = %s; from each stock's first trade, net of costs",
       CMP[[1]]$comb_label), x = NULL, y = NULL) + thp, "30_all_sharpe.png")
```
